jobs.title: Project Manager, Manhattan Active WMS
jobs.description:
Be Part of enVista’s Next Chapter

enVista is the leading global supply chain consulting and automation firm, helping organizations optimize supply chain and distribution operations from strategy through execution. With 25+ years of experience serving thousands of leading brands, enVista combines deep expertise across supply chain strategy, digital transformation, and distribution center optimization to design, build, implement and optimize high-performing operations within the four walls and across the broader supply chain.

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager with expertise in Manhattan Associates Active Warehouse Management System (WMS) and a proven track record in successfully implementing WMS solutions. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional project management skills, strong technical knowledge of WMS platforms, and the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within budget.

This is more than just a consulting role, it’s an opportunity to be a thought leader and change-maker at a pivotal time in enVista’s journey. We are investing in our people, systems, and future, and we’re looking for bold innovators who want to build with us.

Why enVista?

Our associates help organizations solve complex supply chain challenges and optimize operations from strategy through execution. We support our people with comprehensive onboarding and training, award, and recognition programs, volunteer and affinity groups, and a strong mentoring culture. We are committed to growing top talent and giving our associates the tools to thrive.

If you’re ready to step into a high-impact role with a company that’s growing, innovating, and leading the market, this is your opportunity.

Apply today and be part of enVista’s next chapter.

What You Will Do

WMS Implementation Planning:
Lead the planning and initiation phase of WMS implementation projects, including scoping, resource allocation, and timeline development.
Collaborate with key stakeholders to define project objectives, deliverables, and success criteria.
Develop a comprehensive project plan, considering dependencies, risks, and contingencies.

Project Monitoring and Control:
Track project progress, identify risks, and proactively address issues to ensure successful project delivery.
Regularly communicate project status, milestones, and risks to stakeholders and executive management.
Monitor project budget, resource utilization, and timelines to ensure adherence to project constraints.

Team Leadership:
Assemble and lead a cross-functional project team, consisting of business analysts, developers, subject matter experts, and other relevant stakeholders.
Provide guidance and support to team members throughout the project lifecycle.
Foster a collaborative and results-oriented work environment.

Requirements Analysis and Solution Design:
Conduct thorough requirements gathering and analysis to understand business needs and align them with WMS capabilities.
Work closely with business users and subject matter experts to define system requirements, workflows, and process improvements.
Collaborate with solution architects and technical teams to design an optimal WMS solution that meets business requirements.

WMS Implementation and Configuration:
Oversee the configuration, customization, and testing of the Manhattan Associates Active WMS platform to align with business processes and requirements.
Manage all aspects of the implementation project, including system configuration, integration with other systems, data migration, and user acceptance testing.
Ensure compliance with project governance, change management processes, and industry best practices.

Application and Integration Testing:
Develop and execute a comprehensive testing strategy for the WMS implementation, including unit testing, system testing, and integration testing.
Collaborate with the development team to ensure that all system components are thoroughly tested and meet functional and performance requirements.
Identify and track defects, working closely with the development team to resolve issues promptly.
Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) with key stakeholders to validate the system against business requirements and obtain sign-off for implementation.

Training and Documentation:
Develop and execute training plans for end-users, ensuring smooth adoption and effective utilization of the WMS system.
Create comprehensive documentation, including user manuals, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and training materials.

Go-Live Preparation and Readiness:
Lead the go-live preparation activities, ensuring that all necessary components are in place for a successful system launch.
Collaborate with stakeholders to develop a detailed go-live plan, including cutover activities, data migration, and user training.
Coordinate with the IT infrastructure team to ensure the availability and readiness of hardware, networks, and system environments.
Conduct end-to-end testing to validate system functionality and data integrity before go-live.
Develop contingency plans and risk mitigation strategies to address potential issues during the go-live phase.
Provide guidance and support to end-users during the transition period, addressing any concerns or issues that may arise.
Monitor system performance and user feedback post-go-live, making necessary adjustments and enhancements to ensure a smooth operational transition.

What You Will Bring

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (such as Information Systems, Supply Chain Management, or Business Administration) is preferred
5+ years in Supply Chain Consulting
Proven experience as a Project Manager, leading successful Manhattan Associates WMS implementation projects, preferably with Active WMS
Strong understanding of WMS concepts, functionality, and best practices
Excellent project management skills, including project planning, resource allocation, risk management, and stakeholder communication
Ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive project deliverables
Solid analytical and problem-solving abilities with keen attention to detail
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Travel expectations up to 50%

What We Offer

Competitive Pay + Performance Bonuses– Your impact matters, and we make sure it shows in your paycheck
Comprehensive Health Coverage– Medical, Dental, and Vision and Prescription coverage, along with HSA/FSA options that work for you and your family
Time to recharge and give back– Flexible paid time off (PTO), holidays and unlimited volunteering days
Paid Sabbatical– After seven years of service, take a well-earned break to rest, recharge, or explore
Financial security & retirement– Employed matched 401k, planning and hardship resources, disability and life insurance
Flexible Work Options– Balance life and work with hybrid and remote opportunities that support how you thrive
Employee Referral Bonus– Know someone amazing? Get rewarded for bringing top talent into the enVista family

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At enVista, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $100,000 to $130,000.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Works with management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain. Establishes scope and milestones for each aspect of a technical program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals. Manages technical programs and complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business. Manages highly complex issues, bottlenecks and/or risks, escalating issues when appropriate. Leads technical program improvement, implementing best practices and driving cross-team process optimizations to improve processes. Leads efforts to integrate continuous improvement within technical programs, driving insights across many workstreams to generate recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies. Facilitates collaboration across multiple teams, driving technical discussions that align priorities and program goals. Provides technical expertise, direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams. Creates and automates reporting, partnering with development teams to continue improving reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models to help manage technical program execution. Acts as a technical liaison with or between stakeholder teams, driving effective collaboration for customer success within Oracle commitments.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Ensures that product or service delivery meets the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Drives rapid response to security escalations, coordinating across teams and communicating to executives to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and align and execute optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Forecasts program demands and resourcing to identify risks and ensure that goals are achievable.

– Leads the development and implementation of evolving processes to ensure that organizational SLAs are met.

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify, track, and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Supports planning by identifying dependencies and risks.

– Develops delivery standards and guidelines in alignment with Oracle best practices.

– Identifies and quantifies opportunities for process automations and advocates for prioritization.

– Contributes to incident management efforts and identifies opportunities to improve processes, as applicable.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

– Aligns priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones for each program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals.

– Assists in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for program performance against established goals (e.g., scope, timelines, deliverable quality).

– Builds, maintains, and executes a clear communication strategy of objectives to partners and customers, influencing decision-making regarding best practices for Oracle systems.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

– Manages both technical and non-technical programs and complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides the work of program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success) while providing technical support and direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

– Maintains comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and documents risks and issues.

– Ensures attention to detail in program management from planning to execution and reporting.

– Leads regular program status meetings and keeps teams and leadership informed.

– Leads initiatives within the team to improve operational efficiency and enhance adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity targets.

– Ensures ownership and accountability for forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Guides the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, or requirement changes.

Program Oversight - Risk Management:

– Manages highly complex issues, bottlenecks and/or risks, escalating issues when appropriate.

– Conducts comprehensive assessments of costs, benefits, and return on investment (ROI) to inform decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Manages critical issues while making trade-offs between business needs and technical constraints.

– Removes blockers for the program and identifies new technical and resource options to efficiently deliver solutions and drive adoption.

Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:

– Leads program improvement, implementing best practices and driving cross-team process optimizations to improve processes.

– Organizes and develops program objectives and workflows, while testing and deploying cross-functional solutions to address critical business problems.

– Collaborates with management to initiate and maintain processes and procedures that guide and assist teams in reaching their goals.

Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:

– Leads efforts to integrate continuous improvement within programs, driving insights across many workstreams to generate recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies.

– Develops and standardizes data-driven decision-making frameworks, ensuring insights drive efficiencies.

– Identifies and addresses gaps to facilitate business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.

– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.

– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Cross Functional Collaboration:

– Facilitates collaboration across multiple teams, driving discussions that align priorities and program goals.

– Leads medium-scale efforts to optimize processes, identifying and implementing solutions that enhance team efficiency.

– Delivers program updates, risks, and opportunities to managers and leadership, influencing decision-making.

– Develops relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring their perspectives are integrated into program planning and execution.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:

– Leads programs to continuously improve organizational efficiency.

– Provides technical direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams.

– Influences and guides change at all levels of the group from initiation through delivery.

– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.

Data and Analysis:

– Creates and automates reporting, partnering with development teams to continue improving reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models to help manage program execution.

– Utilizes data to solve moderately complex problems impacting the success of the program(s), including adherence to SLAs.

– Conducts analysis on a small number of data sources with moderate complexity, which may include competitive analysis, trend analysis, and KPI analysis, to drive data-informed decisions to support the program goals, presenting findings with immediate teams stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement:

– Acts as a liaison with or between stakeholder teams, driving effective collaboration for customer success within Oracle commitments.

– Manages relationships with internal and external stakeholders to align program priorities and commitments.

– Identifies and documents stakeholder needs and works cross-functionally to implement solutions that enhance satisfaction.

– Identifies risks to customer satisfaction and advocates for improvements or mitigation.

– Assesses risks to customer satisfaction and evaluates mitigation efforts, providing solutions to the immediate team and related teams to ensure alignment on resolving these risks.

– Helps balance team priorities and Oracle commitments to ensure optimal coverage and response to key customer needs, minimizing risks to the program.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

– Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

Collaboration & Partnership:

– Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Problem Solving:

– Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

Continuous Learning:

– Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

Continuous Improvement:

– Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

Performance and Development:

– Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Design Quality
jobs.description:
About Rivian

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.

Role Summary

Design Quality makes sure the design intent signed off in Studio is what customers see and touch in production. As Staff TPM, you will be the cross-functional program lead for Design Quality, integrating DVAC (AAR), CMF and Studio Design Ops activities into one plan, from studio design intent through production release and launch.

You will give Studio, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Purchasing and Manufacturing a single view of schedule, dependencies, decisions and risk. Drive issue closure, report to program and executive leadership, and bring AI into how Design Quality plans, tracks and reports its work.

Responsibilities

Own the integrated Design Quality plan across vehicle programs, linking studio milestones (design reviews, clay and buck builds, virtual reviews, design freeze) to engineering, tooling, build and launch gates.
Plan and drive DVAC (AAR) activities, submissions and approvals for appearance-critical parts, and integrate supplier deliverables and schedules into the program plan
Own Studio program timing: color, material and finish targets, master standards, physical samples and approvals across palettes with different lead times
Partner with Studio Design Ops to sequence studio activities, and translate studio decisions into engineering and supplier commitments and the reverse
Lead Studio and Engineering convergence reviews: present options, trade-offs and recommendations so leadership can make timely decisions
Manage design change: assess schedule, cost and quality impact, and keep changes controlled and visible
Be the issue-resolution champion: drive root cause, mitigation and escalation, and track every issue to closure
Report status, risks and decisions at program gateways and executive reviews
Deliver AI-enabled improvements to DQ workflows as a program deliverable, such as automated status and risk reporting and review-finding analysis, and set standards of work including responsible AI use

Qualifications

8+ years of experience in automotive OEM, Tier 1 or a similar technical field, including 5+ years in technical program management
Experience working in an automotive design studio environment with designers, modelers and studio engineers
Working background in Appearance Approval (AAR) Processes on a vehicle program
Working knowledge of CMF (color, material, finish) specification, validation and approval, including master standards and physical sample management
Technical fluency in vehicle development and the design-to-production process (design freeze, release, tooling, launch) to ask the right questions of engineers and suppliers
Strong program management and execution: able to define the schedule and critical path, control change and adjust priorities as urgent issues arise
Ability to lead through influence, not reporting structure, across Studio, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Purchasing and Manufacturing
Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting options, risks and recommendations to executives and driving decisions
Ability to integrate AI into program delivery as a deliverable: identify use cases, run pilots, measure results and make them repeatable
BA or BS in engineering, design or a related discipline; MS preferred
Hands-on experience applying AI (generative AI, LLM tools, automation or analytics) to program management, quality or design workflows preferred
Jira, Confluence or Smartsheet and dashboard experience preferred
Vehicle launch experience at an EV maker or fast-growing company preferred

Pay Disclosure

The salary range for this role is $154,000- 192,500 for Southern California based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com.

You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). This job is not expected to be closed any sooner than May 25, 2026.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.

Candidate Data Privacy and Technology

Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Rivian may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian affiliates; and (iii) Rivian’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.

Rivian may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.

How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Rivian uses iCIMS Talent Cloud Artificial Intelligence (TCAI) and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.

AI does not make hiring decisions: Qualified candidate applications are reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

Participation in AI profile matching is entirely voluntary. If you prefer that your profile not be used in this process, you can opt out at any time. Opting out means your profile will be excluded from automated matching and will not be surfaced for additional roles through this system. Your current application remains active and will not be affected in any way.

Interview Integrity & AI Policy

Our interview process is designed to evaluate your personal technical foundation, real-time problem-solving logic, and structured capabilities. Therefore, the use of assistive generative AI tools to formulate or deliver your solutions during live interview sessions is not permitted
. We care most about how you think — how you make sense of unclear requirements, weigh trade-offs, and explain why you chose one approach over another. We value your unique human perspective, your authenticity, and the journey it takes to reach a solution.

Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant- Project/Program Manager
jobs.description:
**This role is not eligible for 100% remote work. Employees must live within a commutable distance of the Los Angeles and Orange County Metropolitan Area. Employees must be willing to be onsite at the client in Los Angeles/Orange County and/or Slalom Los Angeles/Orange County office up to 5 days a week.**

Role: 
Senior Project/Program Manager 
Title: 
Senior Consultant
Location:
Los Angeles and/or Orange County

Who You’ll Work With
At Slalom, our Delivery capability is the engine that powers transformation. We are the connective tissue across all capabilities—bringing strategy to life through execution that is rigorous, adaptive, and outcome-driven.
You’ll join a community of delivery professionals who thrive in complexity and are passionate about making things happen. Our teams lead high-impact initiatives across industries, partnering with clients to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver results that matter. Whether it’s a multi-workstream transformation or a product launch, we bring clarity, structure, and momentum to every engagement.
We work shoulder-to-shoulder with clients, tailoring delivery approaches to meet them where they are—whether Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid. Our focus is on enabling predictable, repeatable outcomes that help organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows.
What You’ll Do
Lead the planning and execution of large complex, multi-workstream initiatives across different domains - i.e. modernization initiatives (data, cloud, AI).
Translate ambiguous, high-impact challenges into structured delivery strategies, operating models, and execution plans. 
Manage cross-functional teams including business, product, technology, operations, vendors, and executive stakeholders.
Lead multiple complex concurrent projects with multiple workstreams, portfolios, or enterprise-wide transformation programs.
Partner with senior client leaders to define success metrics, decision frameworks, and scalable ways of working. 
Manage interdependencies, risks, and constraints while driving prioritization, trade-offs, and delivery decisions. 
Manage project financials including forecasting, budgeting, and resource planning. 
Establish and scale governance, processes, and delivery standards to enable consistent, high-quality outcomes. 
Apply and scale delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid) based on client context and organizational maturity. 
Leverage delivery tools and AI-enabled capabilities (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Planner, Smartsheet) to support planning, backlog management, reporting, and decision-making. 
Mentor teams, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational alignment.

What You’ll Bring
8+ years of consulting experience leading technology projects and business transformation initiatives in roles such as Senior Project Manager, Program Manager, Senior Business Analyst, or Delivery Lead.
Advanced knowledge of Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
Strong understanding of AI concepts and hands-on experience supporting initiatives involving AI-enabled solutions, intelligent automation, machine learning, advanced analytics, or digital transformation platforms.
Deep understanding of the full project and software development lifecycle, from strategy and business case development through implementation and operational transition. 
Solid technical foundation with familiarity across enterprise applications, software development practices, cloud technologies, integrations, and IT infrastructure. 
T echnical fluency with modern software engineering practices, including familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT/Copilot), Visual Studio Code, GitHub, source control workflows, and CI/CD concepts.
Bachelor’s degree in a related field; certifications such as CSM, PMP, CBAP, scaled agile preferred .  

About Us
Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. 
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. 
Compensation and Benefits
Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance.
Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges:  The targeted base salary pay range for Senior Consultant in Orange County or Los Angeles is $110,000 to $153,000.   In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus .  Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.    
We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at:  peopleone@slalom.com . Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose.
EEO and Accommodations
Slalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact  accomodationrequest@slalom.com  if you require accommodations during the interview process.

jobs.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Information Security Analyst is primarily responsible for reviewing and analyzing the various security systems we have in place and determining whether further investigation or remediation is required in order to maintain the integrity of the firm’s systems and information. This position plays a critical role in the malware kill chain, acting independently at the prevent, detect and respond levels of information security.

Location

This position can sit in any US office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Aligns security alert review and hunting to prescribed Incident Response Playbook.
Conducts limited investigations into security breaches at firm sites using high-fidelity alerts and tools within the environment, MSSP and online.
Reviews alerts generated by security detection tools, correlates with device logs, packets capture and all forms of telemetry; interprets data.
Maintains up-to-date information in alert handling tools.
Where firm SLA governs timing, the analyst must work within the timing bounds to acknowledge and resolve alerts.
Vigilantly protects client and firm data, ensuring proper handling and protection electronically, physically and verbally.
Other duties as assigned.

Skills And Competencies

Must have detailed experience of TCP/IP.
Strong understanding of Windows operating systems.
Experience scripting in PowerShell, Perl, or Python.
Preferred experience includes: experience with Snort or other intrusion detection tools; anomaly detection, full-package capture; centralized logging and monitoring tools such as Splunk; Nessus/Security Center; and experience operating in and complying with ISO 27001:2013.
Understanding a common malware as well as typical attack chain.
Understanding of the common technologies found in enterprise IT environments including datacenter and Internet edge technologies.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Education

Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or related field required.

Certifications

jobs.title: AXA Health Business - Senior Project Manager - EB Partners F/H
jobs.description:
VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS

AXA is expanding its Employee Benefits activities internationally, supported by AXA EB Partners, a specialized Insurtech bringing together Employee Benefits expertise, digital delivery, data capabilities and integration excellence.

Founded in 2015, EB Partners brings together more than 75 internal and external team members across France, Japan and Vietnam. Its solutions currently support clients in 18 countries across Employee Benefits and Health.

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to join the EB Partners Service Excellence team and lead international initiatives around our Service Platform, a modular digital ecosystem designed for employees, employers, distributors and administrators.

You will work at the intersection of business, customer experience and technology, coordinating international stakeholders and helping local markets deliver engaging, scalable and locally relevant digital experiences. Projects span markets including France, Spain, Germany, Japan, Hong Kong and the Philippines, with opportunities to support further international expansion.

As Senior Project Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of Service Platform implementations and enhancements, from initial discovery and co-design through configuration, integration, UAT, deployment, adoption and post-go-live stabilization.You will:

Lead international implementations of Employee, Employer, Distributor and Admin portals, coordinating local AXA teams and EB Partners specialists.
Translate business and user needs into clear customer journeys, requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria and delivery roadmaps.
Manage project scope, planning, milestones, dependencies, risks, governance and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams covering UX/UI, low-code/no-code configuration, development and systems integration.
Promote a modular, reusable approach, leveraging existing global capabilities while adapting solutions to local business, regulatory and operational requirements.
Coordinate integration requirements including authentication and SSO, APIs, data exchanges, document services, notifications, e-signature, payment and third-party services where applicable.
Drive UAT, release readiness, training, deployment, adoption and post-launch support.
Help shape healthcare and wellbeing service ecosystems by coordinating insurers, healthcare or wellbeing providers and other partners.
Identify and assess opportunities for AI-enabled services, including AI chatbots and AI agents, and translate relevant use cases into pragmatic roadmaps considering business value, user experience, data readiness, integration, security, privacy and responsible AI.
Facilitate workshops, steering committees and working groups, ensuring clear decisions, ownership and follow-up.
Support local teams in building sustainable ownership of the platform and its configurable capabilities.

VOTRE PROFIL

You have at least 5 years of professional experience, with meaningful responsibility for digital portal, self-service, low-code/no-code or technology-enabled insurance projects. More than formal programme-management credentials, we value your ability to independently drive stakeholders, adoption and delivery outcomes.

You bring:

Proven experience delivering customer, partner, employee or comparable B2B/B2C digital portals, from discovery through production rollout and adoption.
Strong project management fundamentals across planning, governance, scope, risks, dependencies, UAT, release management and stakeholder decision-making.
A good understanding of digital delivery topics such as UX/UI, CMS or low-code/no-code platforms, authentication/SSO, APIs and data interfaces.
The ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements and delivery decisions for multidisciplinary teams.
Experience working in agile or hybrid environments and proficiency with Jira and Confluence.
Experience working in an international, matrixed environment with distributed teams.
Fluent written and spoken English. Business-level French is preferred for French projects.
Knowledge of Employee Benefits or insurance across Health, Protection or Pension is a strong advantage, as is familiarity with healthcare and wellbeing ecosystems.
Previous IT development experience is a plus

What Will Help You Succeed

You are comfortable taking ownership and moving projects forward without waiting for detailed direction. You know how to bring together stakeholders with different priorities, cultures and ways of working, and turn complexity into clear decisions and actions.

You combine a pragmatic, analytical mindset with strong communication skills. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, negotiating priorities and escalating risks early with practical options.

You are also curious about how emerging technologies, particularly generative AI, AI chatbots and AI agents, can improve digital services while meeting security, privacy, operational and responsible-AI requirements.

The environment you will join

EB Partners’ Service Platform combines reusable portal components with a low-code/no-code Builder platform to accelerate time to market while enabling local teams to adapt content and configurations.

The wider platform supports Employee Benefits journeys including enrolment, benefits and services, documents, claims, reporting and user administration, alongside capabilities such as digital claims management, enrolment automation and premium billing.

The role involves working across countries, cultures and time zones and may require international travel when necessary, mainly to EB Partners’ office in France.

Ready to help shape the next generation of digital Employee Benefits services? Join AXA EB Partners and help turn global capabilities into impactful local experiences

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

Nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs ! Les avantages que nous proposons à nos salariés sont nombreux.

Nous choisir, c’est bénéficier par exemple :

D’un package de rémunération complet comprenant un salaire fixe, un complément de rémunération variable, des primes, de la participation et de l’intéressement, la possibilité d’acquérir des actions AXA, ou encore des solutions d’épargne avantageuses ;

De la possibilité de s’engager pour une cause qui vous tient à cœur grâce à nos associations telles que AXA Atout Cœur, AXA Compétences Solidaires ou encore AXA Prévention ;
Et bien plus encore ! Perspectives de développement des compétences et de carrières immenses, CE, conciergerie, offres privilèges, soutien en cas d’épreuve personnelle…On s’arrête là, la liste est longue !

VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL

Notre raison d’être chez AXA ? Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour le progrès humain en protégeant ce qui compte dans + de 50 pays. Accompagner près de 95 millions de clients à chaque étape de leur vie, une mission qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin à nos employés et agents (+ de 145 000 dans le monde !)

Chez AXA, nous sommes riches de nos singularités et accueillons tous les profils dans leur diversité. Au-delà de mener une politique inclusive engagée, nous agissons au quotidien en tant qu’employeur citoyen et responsable pour des causes sociétales & environnementales. Ces ambitions vous parlent ? Alors rejoignez un des leaders de l’assurance et venez changer le monde avec nous !

Présente sur l'ensemble du territoire, AXA France se distingue comme la filiale la plus importante du Groupe en termes de chiffre d'affaires et d'effectifs. Leader sur les marchés de l'assurance, de la santé et de la prévoyance, l'entreprise offre à ses équipes un cadre de travail moderne et agréable en "smartworking".

Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nous avons conçu un dispositif d'intégration baptisé "Welcome@AXA" pour accompagner vos premiers pas parmi nous avec attention. En lien avec nos engagements, nous célébrons chaque arrivée en agissant en faveur de la reforestation mondiale : depuis 2020, nous plantons un arbre pour chaque recrutement. Alors, prêt à postuler ?

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

Salary:

$110,500.00 - $152,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. Company

Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale helps our customers – who make smartphones, supercomputers, virtual reality headsets, autonomous vehicles and more – transform their ideas into reality.

The technologies we create are the foundational building blocks of the future. Our systems make semiconductor devices, called chips—"the brains" of the electronics used in almost every aspect of our lives. The promise of new and exciting applications, transforming industries such as consumer electronics, transportation, communications, healthcare, and supercomputing/AI, are enabled by advances in semiconductor and display technology.

While virtually every nationality, culture, and background are currently represented within Applied Materials, we strive for a more robust Culture of Inclusion (COI) and diversity. Leveraging our COI vision helps drive innovation, build organizational capabilities, create equal opportunities for everyone and achieve our company’s definition of Winning.

Our innovations Make Possible® a Better Future. If you’re looking for the next step in your future, consider Applied Materials. With the data explosion and new investment in semiconductors, it’s an exciting place to be.

Role

Project Manager, Tools Installations & Upgrades will report to the Manager, R&D Lab Tool Installations & fit-up Upgrades .
The individual will be responsible to provide broad and impactful leadership of tool installations within the Silicon Valley area.

The R&D Lab Tool Installations and Upgrades team is accountable for lab tool install design, permitting, and construction, including Lab process and building system infrastructure upgrades. Total annual Capital Expenditures for this team exceeds $50m and is increasing. The team consists of 20+ Applied Materials full time employees and 300+ project construction managers, design, and construction, contractors. Your role will be to manage projects.

Be responsible for establishing highly credible and effective partnerships with multiple internal business groups for whom the labs support.

Key Responsibilities

Execute Applied Materials’ Tool Installations & Upgrades to achieve key business objectives through reduced project cycle time.
Responsible to safely design, plan, execute, construct, start-up, and commission advanced semiconductor R&D lab facilities upgrades and tool installations in Silicon Valley.
Oversee a team of facility PM’s in the preparation and management of project plans, scope, schedule, and budget through all phases of design, contracting, construction, start-up and commissioning.
Order long lead equipment & materials and review & approve engineering submittals with stakeholders.
Serve as a leader with whom multiple Applied Materials business units collaborate to develop strategies that align with key business objectives.
Ability to respond to changing corporate business environments. Adjusting plans as needed.
Designs, develops and implements organizational policies and procedures relevant to the facilities department.
Collaborate with planning department peers for optimal solutions and transition into project execution within the group.

others to transfer documentation, schedules, and other information.

Excellent communicator/collaborator, with the ability to clearly and concisely articulate ideas and concepts and the ability to build strong working teams, cultures, and relationships at all levels and with customers, subcontractors, vendors, and other community leaders. You are a proactive self-starter who takes ownership and follows through

The manager is a creative, proactive resource for clients, especially those with legal operations functions.

A key aspect of the manager’s role is to use their experience to influence outcomes and engage in process improvement and change management.

Proactively seeks opportunities to collaborate with legal operations professionals by piloting new solutions, improving processes and addressing client pain points.
Develops, maintains and enhances a portfolio of resources that help lawyers identify and communicate to clients the cost and scope of legal work, spot risks for cost overruns, monitor run rate and leverage the firm’s technology and knowledge resources to optimize legal service delivery.
Establishes and partners with a network of peers in Finance, Business Development, Practice Development, Knowledge Management and other staff support teams to design and deliver innovative solutions, leverage AI appropriately and improve processes.
Uses team technology platforms and applies effective data storytelling techniques to help attorneys optimize matter management and answer clients' questions; analyzes financial metrics and data, using it to raise issues and make recommendations to lawyers.

:

Able to build relationships, influence and foster a collaborative approach with internal clients across practice groups and with all departments and levels of the organization.
Can effectively convey solutions to stakeholders, explaining results within a legal project management framework and achieving buy-in from legal teams.

Demonstrated experience in leading teams and creative problem-solving.

Job Description

About the Team

At Carbon, our mission goes beyond 3D printing. We are enabling creators everywhere to make what the world needs, right now. Our company is built on the idea that diverse fields of study must come together to solve intractable problems. We have grand ambitions to create technology that will influence industry around the world. Help us change the world and we will help you change yours.

Role Summary

At Carbon, we're revolutionizing manufacturing, and we're looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the end-to-end delivery of a multi-million-dollar program involving new technology, regulatory compliance, and the development of operational infrastructure to support our strategic business objectives.

In this role, you'll work closely with our engineering, operations, legal, and finance teams to drive the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional programs that push the boundaries of additive manufacturing. You'll also lead technical and program engagements with key customers, ensuring we deliver on time and meet program requirements.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in some of Carbon's most ambitious and high-impact initiatives while helping advance our mission.

This is a full-time, onsite position based in Sunnyvale, CA, with occasional domestic travel required.

Responsibilities

Program leadership and delivery

Own the integrated master schedule, scope, budget, and milestones across all workstreams, for the duration of the project.
Influently lead cross-functional teams (engineering, legal, finance, contracts, security, and external partners) to achieve aggressive targets in complex product development and NPI programs.
Establish governance for the programs to inform stakeholders, drive effective decisions, and escalate effectively using appropriate tools and methodologies.
Coordinate complex technical programs across Carbon's Software, Hardware, and Materials Development teams to enable the delivery of next-generation 3D printing solutions.
Facilitate effective communication between internal and external teams, escalating issues when necessary to ensure smooth integration of cross-team innovations, while identifying and mitigating risk in the development of products and services.
Ensure that program outcomes align with Carbon's overall strategy.

Technical development

Partner with engineering to translate contractual and customer requirements into technical requirements, and maintain traceability through design, testing, and acceptance.
Engage with engineering leadership on matters of technical risk and timeline tradeoffs.
Manage dependencies, integration, and verification/validation activities with operations and customers.
Create and foster customer relationships in support of user story creation, manufacturing integration, and production optimization.

Compliance and regulatory

Ensure the program meets applicable requirements, including those flowed down through commercial agreements, including export controls (ITAR/EAR), cybersecurity frameworks, and technical data handling requirements.
Partner with core product development, legal, facility, EH&S, and IT teams to establish and implement appropriate policies & procedures for safe and secure handling of physical products and technical data.

Commercial agreement and contract management

Partner with business development to track obligations, milestones, and IP or data rights provisions, while managing cost and schedule as outlined within the contract agreements.
Support partnership, subcontracting, or joint venture arrangements that the program depends on.
Provide programmatic input to due diligence, business cases, or strategic investment decisions.

12+ years in program or project management, with at least 5 leading complex, technical, large-scale strategic programs.
Demonstrated experience delivering programs in a government, defence, or other regulated environment, along with a working knowledge of government contracting structures and commercial agreements.
Excellent project management skills, including experience with project management frameworks in multidisciplinary environments.
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge gaps between diverse technical and operational disciplines, through understanding and effective communication of technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Significant experience implementing best-in-class methodologies to accelerate technical development and delivery.
Strategic thinking, decision-making under ambiguity, clear written and verbal communication, negotiation, and the judgment to know when issues must be escalated.
Strong technical foundation (often a bachelor’s degree or working experience in engineering, material science, or a related field).
Familiarity with ITAR regulations and compliance.
Track record of managing both internal and external executive stakeholders.

Beneficial Qualifications

Experience in advanced manufacturing, robotics, or materials development programs.
Familiarity with NPI (New Product Introduction) processes for projects resulting in manufacturing at scale.
Experience working in a fast-paced, technology-led organization with tight cross-functional dependencies.
Experience and passion for advanced manufacturing, materials development, or 3D printing technologies
Project management certification (DAWIA or FAC-P/PM; PMP or PgMP).
Experience with corporate development activities such as partnerships, M&A integration, or strategic alliances.
Advanced degree (MBA or technical master’s).

Export Control Requirements

Due to the nature of the work, this position is subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and requires applicants to be a “U.S. Person” as defined in 22 CFR

120.15.

Salary Paragraph

At Carbon, we look at the person holistically and carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining salary. The compensation bracket for this position is $209,600 - $314,400 per year. In order to maintain equitable internal pay practices, we aim to hire new employees near the midpoint of $262,000, taking into account your experience, work location, certifications, and the unique skills you bring to the role. If you are not based in our Redwood City office, the range above will be adjusted for the geographical differential associated with your actual work location.

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. Santa Clara,CA

We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Role Overview

Central Engineering is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the development and commercialization of Central Engineering capabilities required by Etch products.

This role has end-to-end program accountability for complex, cross-functional initiatives spanning platform, robotics and automation, software, systems integration, and advanced R&D capabilities. The TPM will work across Etch product groups and Central Engineering functions to translate product and chamber requirements into clearly scoped engineering programs and drive those programs from requirements definition through development, system integration, lab readiness, customer introduction, and commercialization.

The TPM is expected to operate as an accountable program owner, not simply as a coordinator between organizations. The role owns program definition and execution across multiple engineering organizations, including scope, priorities, deliverables, schedule, resources, dependencies, risks, customer introduction, and Product Development Process execution.

Success requires strong technical judgment, systems thinking, program leadership, and the ability to drive execution across organizations where engineering resources and priorities must be negotiated and aligned.

Key Responsibilities

Program Ownership and Execution

Own end-to-end execution of cross-functional technical programs supporting Etch product development and commercialization, from initial requirements and program definition through engineering development, integration, lab validation, customer introduction, and release.
Serve as the single-point accountable owner for Product Development Process execution for assigned Central Engineering programs supporting Etch.
Establish clear program scope, objectives, technical requirements, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, dependencies, risks, and success criteria.
Drive programs to deliver integrated, working solutions, ensuring individual engineering deliverables come together successfully at the system level rather than managing functional activities independently.
Maintain accountability for program commitments and proactively drive recovery plans when technical, resource, schedule, or integration issues place commitments at risk.

Requirements And Systems Integration

Partner with Etch product and engineering organizations to scope and translate chamber and product requirements into requirements for Central Engineering capabilities, including platform, robotics and automation, software, controls, systems engineering, and advanced R&D technologies.
Drive requirements alignment across product, chamber, platform, software, robotics, and engineering organizations to ensure interfaces, dependencies, and system-level requirements are clearly understood.
Work across multiple technical disciplines to identify integration risks, architecture dependencies, qualification requirements, and gaps that could impact product readiness or customer introduction.
Ensure engineering solutions are developed and integrated to meet the needs of the Etch product roadmap and intended customer use cases.

Portfolio, Priority, and Resource Management

Manage a portfolio of Central Engineering programs and capabilities supporting Etch, maintaining visibility across program health, engineering resources, technical maturity, milestones, dependencies, risks, and customer commitments.
Lead the scoping and prioritization of new program requests and determine the engineering capabilities, resources, and organizations required for execution.
Negotiate and align priorities between Etch product groups and Central Engineering functions when resource capacity, technical dependencies, schedules, or competing priorities require trade-offs.
Identify portfolio-level resource constraints and cross-program dependencies early and drive decisions with appropriate engineering and product leadership.
Provide leadership with clear visibility into program health, resource needs, critical risks, decision points, and recovery actions.

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

Work across Product and Engineering disciplines to establish clear ownership and drive teams toward a common technical and program outcome.
Lead cross-functional execution across organizations responsible for platform, robotics, automation, software, controls, systems integration, and advanced engineering technologies.
Drive decisions across organizational boundaries and hold teams accountable for agreed deliverables, timelines, and technical outcomes.
Influence without direct authority by establishing clear requirements, data-driven priorities, decision frameworks, and escalation paths.
Resolve ambiguity around scope, ownership, priorities, interfaces, resources, and execution responsibility before those gaps affect program delivery.

Risk and Customer Introduction

Own identification and management of technical, integration, resource, schedule, qualification, and customer-introduction risks across assigned programs.
Establish mitigation and recovery plans for critical program risks and escalate decisions when cross-organizational alignment or leadership intervention is required.
Coordinate readiness across engineering teams for lab integration, system qualification, product release, and customer introduction.
Ensure issues discovered during system integration or customer introduction are driven to root cause, corrective action, ownership, and closure.

Qualifications

Required

BS or MS degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
5+ years of experience in high-tech product development, systems engineering, systems integration, engineering program management, or technical program management.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, multidisciplinary engineering programs involving multiple engineering organizations and technical dependencies.
Strong understanding of structured product development processes and experience driving programs from requirements through development, integration, qualification, and release.
Demonstrated ability to manage scope, schedules, resources, dependencies, risks, and technical integration across matrixed organizations.
Strong systems thinking and the ability to understand interactions between hardware, software, automation, controls, and product-level requirements.
Demonstrated ability to negotiate priorities and drive decisions and execution without direct authority.
Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate program status, risks, trade-offs, and decisions to technical and business leadership.

Preferred

Experience in semiconductor capital equipment or semiconductor manufacturing technology.
Experience supporting complex semiconductor equipment development involving process chambers, platforms, robotics and automation, controls, embedded or application software, and system integration.
Experience with New Product Development, Product Development Process, NPI, system qualification, and customer introduction.
Familiarity with Etch equipment and technologies such as process chambers, vacuum systems, RF/plasma systems, gas delivery, automation, robotics, controls, and related platform technologies.
Experience driving engineering execution across product engineering, systems engineering, software, hardware, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, service, and business organizations.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate is a technically credible program leader and systems thinker who can operate across both product and engineering organizations.

This person does not need to be the subject-matter expert in every technical discipline, but must be able to understand how the pieces come together at the system level, challenge assumptions, expose gaps and dependencies, and drive engineering organizations toward an integrated solution.

The ideal candidate can take an initially ambiguous product or chamber requirement and turn it into a well-defined technical program with clear requirements, architecture dependencies, engineering ownership, resources, priorities, milestones, risks, and customer deliverables, and then remain accountable until the solution is working and successfully introduced.

Why This Role Matters

Etch products increasingly depend on capabilities that span multiple Central Engineering organizations and technical disciplines. Successful execution requires more than coordination of individual engineering activities. It requires system-level ownership of how those capabilities are scoped, prioritized, developed, integrated, qualified, and delivered as a working solution.

The Technical Program Manager provides that ownership.

By managing both individual programs and the broader portfolio of Central Engineering commitments supporting Etch, this role will improve requirements clarity, resource and priority alignment, engineering integration, risk management, Product Development Process discipline, customer readiness, and predictability of execution.

jobs.title: Certification Operations and Policy Program Manager
jobs.description:
About The Team

Customer Education helps customers build the practical skills and confidence to use AI and OpenAI products safely and effectively. We bring together customer insight, learning and enablement expertise, product signals, and measurement to help organizations move from access to durable adoption.

Within Customer Education, the Certification team helps individuals demonstrate competence for in-demand AI skills and helps customers and partners validate that their workforce has the skills they need to meet their AI-enabled business goals. Our work centers on the belief that learners should understand where to go to build skills and capabilities, how to demonstrate them, and what to pursue next. Similarly, Enterprise leaders should understand what each credential signifies and how it supports workforce readiness. We do this with transparency for the overall OpenAI credential framework and providing trusted, role-based certifications that verify practical capability.

About The Role

As Certification Operations and Policy Program Manager, you will build and run the processes that make OpenAI certifications accessible, fair, and reliable for candidates and the organizations that rely on them.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role on the Certification team, with no direct reports. You will define candidate policies, turn them into practical processes, and own their implementation as the program grows. This is not a general program-management or support-only role: it combines policy development with hands-on operational delivery.

You will work closely with the Certification team, product and technical teams, Legal, Privacy, Security, Accessibility, Support, and delivery vendors to define operational standards and apply policies consistently and fairly. You will connect the partners needed to turn certification requirements into workable candidate processes.

You will start with early certification launches and build reusable playbooks, service standards, and review processes for live and virtual delivery. Initially, you will also triage escalated vendor and candidate cases, resolve routine delivery or credential-access issues, and route substantive appeals through the established independent-review process.

Success means candidates know what to expect, delivery partners know what to do when something goes wrong, and sensitive decisions are documented and independently reviewed.

In This Role, You Will

Define candidate-facing policies and communications across the certification journey, including eligibility, registration, exam rules, retakes, exceptions, expiration, and renewal. Partner with the Certification team to translate program requirements into policy and with Legal, product, technical teams, and vendors to build the processes that uphold it.
Own the accommodations process from request through delivery. Work with Accessibility, Legal, and delivery partners on how requests are reviewed and implemented, and protect sensitive information throughout.
Own certification records and evidence workflows, including results, credential issuance and corrections, and case records. Put approved access, retention, and disclosure rules into practice with Privacy, Security, and platform teams.
Own vendor workflows and operational delivery standards, including handoffs, service levels, readiness checks, and escalation paths. Initially serve as the first point of contact for escalated delivery and credential-access cases, coordinating vendor fixes, candidate communications, and corrective actions.
Coordinate the response to exam integrity incidents, including suspected cheating, impersonation, or unauthorized sharing of exam content. Work with Security, Legal, and delivery vendors to document evidence, route cases to the appropriate decision-makers, and communicate and implement approved outcomes, such as score invalidation or credential revocation.
Administer appeals and independent reviews. Set intake and response timelines, assemble the case record, screen for conflicts of interest, and route decisions to qualified reviewers who were not involved in the original decision. Document and communicate outcomes without deciding cases you administer.
Coordinate Legal guidance on candidate policies, exceptions, and sensitive cases. Translate approved guidance into playbooks and training, and use trends in incidents, appeals, accommodations, and vendor performance to improve delivery.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have owned operations or candidate policy for professional certification, licensure, high-stakes assessment, or a similarly governed program.
Have taken a certification, licensure, or comparable high-stakes program from launch readiness through live delivery, and can show how you used operational data and candidate feedback to identify recurring problems and improve delivery.
Have experience working at a technology company in a fast-paced environment, setting priorities and delivering work amid changing requirements and evolving business needs.
Have defined candidate-facing policies and translated them into clear communications and operational workflows that internal teams and vendors can apply consistently.
Have built or run an accommodations process, implementing candidate accommodations while protecting sensitive information.
Have administered incidents, complaints, appeals, or exceptions, documenting decisions and maintaining review by people who were not involved in the original decision.
Have managed external delivery vendors against service standards and followed through when those standards were not met.
Have handled sensitive candidate, assessment, or credential records and worked with privacy or security teams on appropriate controls.
Have translated complex policies into candidate communications and operational guidance, and coordinated implementation across vendors and internal teams without direct reporting authority.
Have personally written operational playbooks, checked launch readiness, triaged cases, and improved delivery processes.
Have resolved time-sensitive operational issues within established policy and escalated exceptions to the appropriate decision-makers.
Have applied accessibility, fairness, and credential-integrity policies consistently in candidate-facing operations.

It’s a Plus If You Have Experience

Launching or scaling technical certifications across live and virtual delivery.
Working with exam delivery, identity verification, proctoring, credential issuance, or candidate support systems.
Supporting accreditation or quality audits for personnel certification programs.
Building repeatable operating processes across regions, delivery partners, or multiple certification programs.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

CoE NPI Supply Chain is the strategic enterprise integration layer connecting Centers of Excellence (CoE), Business Units, and Global Supply Chain. Product Sourcing Strategy – agile, scalable, resilient product ramp through GSC ecosystems.
Product Cost Performance – product viability and gross margin performance.

Effective Implementation – deploy technology innovations and cost optimization into new products.

jobs.title: Information Security Analyst
jobs.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Information Security Analyst is primarily responsible for reviewing and analyzing the various security systems we have in place and determining whether further investigation or remediation is required in order to maintain the integrity of the firm’s systems and information. This position plays a critical role in the malware kill chain, acting independently at the prevent, detect and respond levels of information security.

Location

This position can sit in any US office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Aligns security alert review and hunting to prescribed Incident Response Playbook.
Conducts limited investigations into security breaches at firm sites using high-fidelity alerts and tools within the environment, MSSP and online.
Reviews alerts generated by security detection tools, correlates with device logs, packets capture and all forms of telemetry; interprets data.
Maintains up-to-date information in alert handling tools.
Where firm SLA governs timing, the analyst must work within the timing bounds to acknowledge and resolve alerts.
Vigilantly protects client and firm data, ensuring proper handling and protection electronically, physically and verbally.
Other duties as assigned.

Skills And Competencies

Must have detailed experience of TCP/IP.
Strong understanding of Windows operating systems.
Experience scripting in PowerShell, Perl, or Python.
Preferred experience includes: experience with Snort or other intrusion detection tools; anomaly detection, full-package capture; centralized logging and monitoring tools such as Splunk; Nessus/Security Center; and experience operating in and complying with ISO 27001:2013.
Understanding a common malware as well as typical attack chain.
Understanding of the common technologies found in enterprise IT environments including datacenter and Internet edge technologies.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Education

Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or related field required.

Certifications

CISSP, SSCP, GCIA or GCIH certification highly preferred.

Years Of Experience

4 years of IT or security experience.

Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;

Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.
