jobs.title: Senior Billing Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About Druva

Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.

Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

Role Purpose & Impact

The Senior Billing Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of customer billing activities. This position is responsible for managing complex billing transactions, reviewing contractual requirements, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining compliance with company policies and accounting standards.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented professional with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a solid understanding of order-to-cash processes, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

In addition to daily billing operations, the Senior Billing Analyst will help identify opportunities for process improvement, strengthen internal controls, and leverage emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools, to drive automation, enhance operational efficiency, and support scalable billing processes.

What You’ll Do

Sales Order Processing and Billing Operations

Process sales orders and customer invoices accurately and timely using Salesforce (SFDC) and NetSuite.
Review and validate sales orders against signed customer agreements, including customer information, products, pricing, billing schedules, and payment terms, to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Identify missing information, order discrepancies, and non-standard contract terms, escalating exceptions to senior team members or management as appropriate.
Ensure transactions are processed in accordance with established billing procedures, company policies, and operational deadlines.
Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation for sales orders, invoices, and billing transactions.

Billing Inquiries and Dispute Resolution

Respond to internal and external customer billing inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
Research billing discrepancies, invoice questions, and customer account issues.
Partner with relevant stakeholders to investigate billing discrepancies, resolve customer disputes, and ensure timely resolution of billing-related issues.
Assist with processing billing corrections, credit memos, and adjustments in accordance with established procedures.
Track outstanding billing issues and follow through to ensure timely resolution.
Escalate complex or unresolved issues to senior team members or management.

Reconciliations and Financial Close Support

Assist with reconciling third-party royalty and channel sales reports against internal order and billing data.
Identify and research discrepancies between external reports and internal transaction records.
Support month-end and quarter-end close activities, including reconciliations and assigned reporting tasks.
Assist in preparing supporting schedules, transaction details, and documentation for accounting close activities.
Ensure assigned deliverables are completed accurately and within established deadlines.

Internal Controls and Compliance

Follow established order-to-cash accounting policies, internal controls, and standard operating procedures.
Support internal control activities and assist with documentation required for SOX compliance.
Assist with internal and external audit requests by gathering transaction records and supporting documentation.
Ensure proper documentation and audit trails are maintained for billing-related transactions.
Identify and communicate potential processing errors, control issues, or policy exceptions to management.

Process Improvement and Systems Support

Who are we?

Volumetric Building Companies
( VBC
) is a vertically integrated global volumetric construction leader, headquartered in Philadelphia, PA. with locations across the United States and in Europe in the UK, Poland and Serbia.

About The Role

The Assistant Project Manager
will be a member of VBC’s U.S. Project Delivery Team and will support the planning and development of projects from early concept and design through project handoff to the execution team. Working closely with Project Managers, Estimating, Design, Procurement, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams, this role will help establish project scope, schedule, budget, and execution strategies to position projects for successful delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with foundational experience in the AEC, construction, engineering, or manufacturing industries who is ready to take the next step in their career. The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment while developing the skills necessary to grow into a Project Manager role.

Key Responsibilities

Preconstruction & Project Planning

Support the development of projects from early concepts through design development and transition to project execution.

Review contract documents, drawings, specifications, and other project documentation to understand project requirements.

Schedule & Procurement Planning

Assist with development and maintenance of project schedules from design through manufacturing and construction.
Track project milestones, deliverables, approvals, and dependencies.
Identify and communicate potential schedule risks, delays, and areas requiring escalation.

Track open issues, decisions, deliverables, and action items through resolution.
Assist in preparing project status updates and reporting project health to Project Management leadership.

Project Handoff & Continuous Improvement

Support the transition of projects from preconstruction into project execution and manufacturing.
Ensure project scope, budget, schedule, design documentation, procurement requirements, and key risks are clearly communicated during handoff.
Assist with identifying lessons learned and opportunities to improve VBC’s preconstruction and project delivery processes.
Contribute to standardization, process improvement, and operational efficiency initiatives.

Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Demonstrate a willingness to learn, take ownership, and progressively assume greater responsibility.

Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a cross-functional team.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.
Positive, proactive attitude with a demonstrated desire to grow into a project management leadership role.

jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

Our ability to deliver complex wireless technology rollouts on time and on budget is critical to driving network innovation for our customers across Upstate New York. Serving as the central operational hub connecting RF/System Performance, Engineering, Network Assurance, HQ/Territory Planning, and external vendors, you’ll lead our 5G VRAN deployment roadmap while keeping regional activation targets on track. When technical program leadership is required, you will step in to align cross-functional teams, eliminate deployment bottlenecks, and ensure day-of integration stability.

Leading the end-to-end implementation of the 5G vRAN deployment and rollout, including guiding a cross-functional team across RF/SP, Engineering, and Network Assurance to establish and maintain the Upstate New York 5G vRAN Implementation Plan, and developing a project plan that clearly captures strategic drivers, technical dependencies, rollout milestones, schedules, and overall status.
Owning end-to-end program and vendor management for the Upstate New York 5G vRAN Implementation Plan—managing master schedules, budgeting, and capital forecasting while driving vendor coordination to resolve design and support gaps before they impact rollout milestones.
Coordinating and scheduling resources across multiple organizations to align project requirements with Territory and HQ business goals and objectives, while developing and implementing corrective action plans to mitigate risks and impacts to project schedules.
Driving deployment execution and risk mitigation to hit regional activation targets, leading complex site transitions (uADPF conversions, C-Band/2FDD NR integrations with SA and VoNR enabled), and managing regional First Office Applications (FOAs) for next-generation hardware.
Managing vendor activities aligned with implementation goals, dedicating heightened focus to 5G vRAN execution to proactively identify and resolve emerging gaps in vendor design and support.
Partnering extensively with Maintenance Engineering, HQ Planning, and Territory Planning on strategic and tactical initiatives, including supporting all FOAs and field testing, executing technological and feature roadmaps, and conducting long-term planning to anticipate network needs for evolving technologies.
Supporting, mentoring, and sharing lessons learned with cross-functional team members while collaborating with HQ, Territory, and other markets to identify, implement, and scale best practices.
Governing integration quality and operational readiness by preventing day-of integration failures and outages through routine Change Quality (CQ) pre-checks and triage management, while overseeing capital build processes and Network Assurance handovers.
Translating complex technical blockers into clear, executive-ready communications that keep HQ, Territory Planning, and regional engineering teams aligned on commitments, risks, and project decisions.
Scaling team efficiency through tooling and automation by serving as the regional Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for deployment platforms (SPM, IOP) and leveraging AI workflows to eliminate manual reporting bottlenecks.

What We’re Looking For...

An expert project manager—organized, detail oriented, and efficient. The ideal candidate must have excellent negotiation skills, and can work effectively with a variety of stakeholders, even in stressful situations. The candidate must be able to resolve problems and overcome hurdles, and approach every situation with a can-do, team-player attitude. The candidate should have a strong technical foundation on the core elements of the wireless network and evolving 5G technology, and a solid history of managing complex projects.

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant work experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
Experience in project managing large multi-functional projects.
Advanced experience with wireless network design and implementation and strong vendor management skills
Knowledge of 5G technology and network design
Experience in planning, forecasting and project management
Hands-on proficiency with network deployment and project tracking platforms, relational databases/reporting, and practical scripting/automation using Python, Playwright, and AI Tools.

Even Better If You Have

A technical degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experiential knowledge of the current 4G evolution, open CPRI and related technology drivers
Strong computer skills and some experience with reporting tools, databases, data design and UIs.
Capable of project managing multiple complex initiatives at the same time.
Ability to solve practical problems and carry out responsibilities with minimal supervision.
Ability to present information in one-on-one and small group situations clearly and concisely.
Excellent interpersonal and communication (both written and verbal) skills.
Highly motivated, organized, self-starter and team player with ability to work in a highly focused, team-centric environment

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this remote role, you'll work from home with occasional in-person trainings and meetings.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Project Manager, Services Technology & Tooling, you will be tasked with helping make our expanded global partnership successful for customers by coordinating the operational technology required for the SentinelOne and partner services relationship. This partnership brings together SentinelOne's AI-powered security platform and our partners' expertise in managed detection and response, managed SIEM, and incident response, and as partner-delivered services grow, SentinelOne remains committed to clear customer ownership, technical quality, and measurable results. This is a delivery-focused program role managing the workstreams covering approved platform access, tenant and environment architecture, integrations, workflow tooling, and technical cutover readiness, requiring disciplined coordination across IT, InfoSec, Product, service operations, and partner technical teams without bypassing security or access controls to meet schedule dates.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

Develop and maintain an integrated technology and tooling workplan with milestones, dependencies, owners, and decisions.
Coordinate SentinelOne and partner stakeholders on approved platform access, tenant models, environment configuration, and integration needs.
Track systems and operational tooling readiness for intake, provisioning, reporting, case handling, and service workflows.
Ensure access requests, security approvals, ownership changes, and data-handling controls are documented and completed through authorized channels.
Drive integration tests, cutover checklists, go/no-go reviews, and post-transition issue tracking.
Surface schedule risks, blocked dependencies, and competing technical priorities to workstream leaders early.
Maintain project status, action logs, risk registers, decision records, and executive-ready reporting.
Work with Support, Professional Services, IT, Product, Security, and partner teams to resolve cross-system issues.
Capture the final access model, integration documentation, and operational handoff required for steady-state support.
Deliver against the role's success measures: timely completion of technology cutover and integration milestones; approved access provisioned accurately and on schedule; no avoidable security-control gaps introduced by the transition; clear readiness evidence and accountable closure of tooling defects; and a stable handoff from project execution to steady-state system ownership.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

3 or more years of experience in technical project management, business systems implementation, IT delivery, or enterprise platform operations.
Experience coordinating integrations, access management, technology migrations, or operational tooling launches.
Familiarity with SaaS platforms, APIs, identity/access concepts, and system dependencies.
Strong project planning, risk management, stakeholder communication, and structured issue resolution.
Ability to work effectively with InfoSec and IT controls around customer data and privileged access.
Proficiency with project tracking, documentation, and collaboration tools.
Comfort managing parallel workstreams without direct authority and with shifting delivery requirements.
Experience with Salesforce, customer support systems, service management tooling, or partner access portals is highly desirable.
Familiarity with security operations tooling and enterprise tenant architectures is highly desirable.
PMP, Agile, or similar project-management training is highly desirable.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

An exclusive partner for premier health systems, Compass has built a nationwide portfolio of ASC joint ventures with health systems and physicians. Compass’ experienced leadership team has developed more than 250 ASCs over the past three decades, making it the partner of choice for high-performance ASCs. Role Overview

Compass Surgical Partners is seeking an Enterprise Project Manager to bring structure, visibility, and accountability to key strategic initiatives across the organization. This role will partner closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure projects are clearly defined, actively managed, and executed with discipline.

The Enterprise Project Manager will help translate priorities into actionable plans, drive alignment across stakeholders, identify risks before they become roadblocks, and provide leaders with clear visibility into project progress, dependencies, and decisions.

Manage timelines and dependencies while proactively addressing risks and resource constraints
Drive follow-through on decisions and commitments across teams
Anticipate challenges and help teams resolve obstacles to keep projects moving

Ensure stakeholders understand upcoming milestones and where decisions or support are needed
Support organizational change by helping teams adopt new processes and ways of working

Tools and Process Improvement

Recommend practical process improvements that strengthen execution without adding unnecessary complexity
Leverage AI tools to streamline documentation and reporting while automating routine project tasks

Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

Reporting to the Digital Technology Solutions (DTS) PMO, the Principal Project Manager is a senior delivery leader responsible for driving complex, cross-functional technology initiatives to successful and predictable outcomes. With primary accountability for the IT and engineering components of an initiative, this role leads delivery across the full project lifecycle, from planning and mobilization through execution, implementation, and transition to operations.

The Principal Project Manager brings structure, discipline, and transparency to complex initiatives by establishing clear scope, integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and accountability. They work closely with engineering teams, business partners, operational teams, vendors, and project and program management counterparts across Alignment to connect work across organizational boundaries and maintain momentum toward shared outcomes.

Success in this role requires strong relationship building and collaboration. The Principal Project Manager establishes trusted partnerships across the company, creates alignment among diverse stakeholders, anticipates delivery challenges, surfaces risks and dependencies early, facilitates timely decisions, and helps teams navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.

The Principal Project Manager also contributes to the continued development of the DTS PMO and our project delivery capabilities. Working collaboratively with PMO leadership, project managers, engineering leaders, and partners across Alignment, this role will lead or contribute to selected workstreams focused on creating repeatable and scalable project management processes, artifacts, tools, reporting, and ways of working that enable predictable delivery. The Principal Project Manager will bring practical experience and lessons learned from active project delivery into this work, helping ensure our standards are useful, adaptable, and effective in practice.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

Strategic Project Management Framework: Design, implement, and govern a standardized, scalable project management methodology (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) that is tailored to our organization's needs and ensures consistency, predictability, and quality in project delivery.
Process Optimization Leadership: Act as the lead subject matter expert in process improvement. Conduct comprehensive analysis of current business processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for automation and optimization.
Capacity and Demand Management: Develop, implement, maintain and report on the capacity of the IT organization to intake work, prioritize it, and report on demand for those resources. This will support work execution and resource planning.
Change Management: Lead the change management initiatives required to ensure the successful adoption of new project management methodologies and optimized business processes across all departments. This includes developing training materials, conducting workshops, and providing ongoing support.
Enterprise Project Management: Lead multiple complex, enterprise-wide initiatives with significant financial and operational impact.
Mentorship and Coaching: Serve as a senior-level mentor and coach to project managers and operational teams. Provide expert guidance on best practices in project planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder communication, as well as process analysis and continuous improvement techniques.
Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for both project health and process efficiency. Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that provide executive leadership with a clear, data-driven view of our project portfolio and operational performance.
Tooling and Technology: Evaluate, select, and optimize project management and business process management (BPM) software and tools to support our methodologies and improve overall efficiency.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with senior leaders and stakeholders across the organization to align project and process optimization initiatives with strategic business goals. Facilitate cross-functional teams to drive and implement complex improvements.
Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and address risks related to project execution and process failures. Develop and implement strategies to mitigate these risks and ensure business continuity.
Continuous Improvement Culture: Foster a culture of continuous improvement by promoting lean principles, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.

Required Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in a combination of project management, process improvement, information technology, and business analysis roles, with a minimum of 5 years in a principal or leadership capacity.
Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) and/or other relevant certifications (e.g., Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Agile, Scrum Master) are required.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field.
Technical & Analytical Skills: Deep expertise in process mapping, data analysis, and the use of process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen).
Leadership & Influence: Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to influence and drive organizational change without direct authority.
Strategic Thinking: Proven ability to develop and execute a strategic vision for project and process management that aligns with and supports business growth.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a meticulous attention to detail.
Tool Proficiency: Advanced proficiency with project management software (e.g., Jira, Asana, Microsoft Project) and process mapping tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart).

Master's degree preferred.
Experience with FreshService or ServiceNow

jobs.description:
Customer Success Project Manager
Job Description

Job Title:
Customer Success Project Manager (CSPM)
Location:
Fully Remote
Employment Type:
Full-time
Salary Range:
Base $60,000–$70,000
Work Schedule:
Core business hours 9–5 pm EST

About Lasso Up

Lasso Up is a growth marketing agency that helps Home Builders, Med Spas, and B2B brands stop chasing random marketing tactics and start generating consistent leads. We replace marketing chaos with a proven Growth Marketing Program, built through strategic branding, web design and development, SEO, content, email, social, and digital advertising, and designed to attract, nurture, and convert new leads.

Our Customer Success Project Managers make that program real. Leadership sets each client's strategy; you turn it into a plan, a team, and a launch. If you take ownership of timelines, communicate directly, and love seeing a well-run project land, this is the place for you.

Role Overview

As a CSPM at Lasso Up, you'll lead new Growth Marketing Program clients through their first 100 days, the most resource-heavy and important stretch of the program, and run complex one-time projects like website builds, branding, and campaign launches. You'll keep scope, budget, and timeline on track with customers externally while orchestrating implementation by our content, design, development, and external teams internally. Once a program is up and running, you'll keep that client in your book of business as their trusted point of contact.
You'll sit on our Customer Success team, working alongside our Customer Success Managers and reporting to the VP of Operations. This role is not a strategist seat: leadership sets each client's strategy, and you own the execution, translating it into project plans, customer-facing assets, and clear direction for the team.

We're looking for a specific kind of person: detail oriented, high driving, and a critical thinker who learns fast. You also must love our customers as much as we do!

We're also investing heavily in AI. Every team member at Lasso Up uses tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and our custom-built AI solutions daily. For this role, hands-on experience using or building with AI is a real advantage.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary of $60,000–$70,000, based on experience
Fully remote — work from anywhere!
Flexible PTO year one, then unlimited PTO
Dead call weeks (no client meetings) at end of each quarter and over Christmas break
15 Paid Federal Holidays
Health insurance options
Simple IRA plan with 3% company match
Company equipment
Paid training and development
Clear promotional path as you take on more accounts and larger projects

Key Responsibilities

Project Management

Lead new Growth Marketing Program clients through onboarding and their first 100 days.
Run multiple one-time projects at once, including website builds, branding, and ad campaign launches, from kickoff through launch.
Manage scope, budget, and timelines across client deliverables, and flag risks early.
Build and manage project boards in Teamwork (or equivalent: Jira, Azure DevOps, Asana, Monday): load tasks, assign resources and dates, and write clear requirements for designers, developers, and writers.
Coordinate with internal Lasso Up teams and external vendors to assign tasks and ensure on-time execution.
Handle scope changes and escalations by presenting clear options to clients: scope, timeline, or cost.
Quality check deliverables before they reach the client.

Account Management

Build and maintain strong client relationships that drive retention, loyalty, and referrals.
Spot upsell opportunities that align with client goals and the Growth Marketing Program, and partner with leadership to scope and price them.
Manage contract renewals and track progress against each client's established benchmarks.
Conduct quarterly reviews to measure progress and communicate results clearly.
Actively seek client referrals and reviews, and request feedback to continuously improve service.
Report on project progress, performance, and ROI on a consistent cadence.
Develop deep knowledge of Lasso Up's services so you can execute confidently and answer client questions.
Manage relationships with external vendors and internal stakeholders to keep work moving.

Strategy Implementation

Take the strategy leadership sets for each client and translate it into project plans, timelines, and Teamwork tasks.
Carry strategy forward into customer-facing assets: presentation materials, website instructions, and ad direction.
Communicate the plan clearly to the service team and the client so everyone is executing toward the same goals.
Use lead generation and results data to confirm work stays aligned with client objectives, and escalate strategy questions to leadership.

AI & Technology

AI is a real part of how we work—not optional, not someday. We're looking for someone who already uses it well and wants to build with it.

Bring hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in your daily work, and put them to work at Lasso Up alongside our custom tools: project planning, requirements, status reporting, client prep, and documentation.
Build and improve AI-assisted workflows that make project delivery faster and more consistent, from task setup to recaps and reporting.
Bring ideas for how AI can improve client results or internal efficiency, and share what's working with the team.
Stay current on what AI can do.
Use AI with good judgment. You're the expert. The tool supports your thinking.

Client Communication & Issue Resolution

Run regular client meetings with clear agendas focused on deliverables, timelines, and next steps, meeting more frequently during a program's first 100 days.
Lead effective presentations: snapshot reporting, a clear purpose, and a defined call to action tailored to your client.
Address client concerns directly and with empathy—take ownership of issues and drive collaborative solutions.
Document all client communications and ensure updates are clearly shared with the right people.
Manage up with demanding clients and stakeholders, and navigate difficult conversations without losing momentum.

Required Skills & Qualifications

3–5 years of project management experience, with a track record of leading project implementations to a successful launch.
A project management certification of any kind, such as PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster, or SAFe Scrum Master.
Experience leading cross-functional teams of designers, developers, and external stakeholders.
Excellent stakeholder management, including managing up with clients.
Comfort running multiple accounts and projects at once without losing sight of timelines, budgets, deliverables, or scope.
A working understanding of website design and development.
Proficiency with a project management tool such as Teamwork, Asana, Monday.com, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) in a professional setting.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with a client-first approach.
Proficiency in Google Suite or Microsoft Suite.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building with AI: custom GPTs or Claude Projects, prompt libraries, or automations (Zapier, Make, or similar).
Marketing, agency, or technology company experience. Any background where you've led designers and developers to launch qualifies.
Familiarity with SEO, content, email, social, or paid ads.
Experience with a CRM (HubSpot or equivalent).
Hands-on experience with SEMrush, Google Analytics, CallRail, or Canva.

What Great Looks Like Here

Average project managers track tasks. Great ones drive launches. Our best performers share four things:
They over-communicate. Clients and teammates always know where things stand.
They sweat the details. They catch the slipped date, the missing requirement, and the out-of-scope ask before it becomes a problem.
They have strong agency. Work moves forward without being pushed.
They address conflict directly. Hard conversations happen, and they move through them.

What Success Looks Like After Year One

One-time projects launched on time, on budget, and in scope.
New Growth Marketing Program clients onboarded smoothly through their first 100 days.
Strong, trusted relationships across your book of business.
AI built into how you plan, run, and report on projects.

Growth Path

We promote from within. This role sits on our Customer Success team, and strong performers have a clear path to senior and leadership roles, with each level defined by measurable competencies—not tenure. If you want to grow, the track is here and the standards are clear.

Why Join Lasso Up?

We're not your typical agency. We're a fully remote team of growth partners who take full ownership of results—for our clients and for each other. We don't chase random tactics or trends. We focus on what actually works, and we build systems that prove it. See it for yourself at lasso-up.com/case-studies.

We're also building a team that uses AI as a real working tool—not a novelty. If you lean into new technology and want to be ahead of where the industry is going, you'll fit right in.

If you want a role where you turn plans into launches—for businesses that deserve to grow—this is it.

Our Core Values

Lead and Respond with Positivity
Over-Communicate
Take Extreme Ownership
Be a Problem Solver
Maintain a Growth Mindset
Keep it Simple

We believe exceptional work and a healthy life aren't in conflict. We build in time to recharge—because staying sharp, positive, and motivated is part of doing great work.

How to Apply

Ready to turn proven growth strategies into launches that work—for our clients and for your career? Submit your resume and a cover letter outlining a project you led to launch and why you're the right project manager for this role.

Join the HJF Team!

HJF is seeking an Aeromedical Mental Health Project Manager
to provide aeromedical mental health expertise to support research, development, test and evaluation for Air Force Research Laboratory, 711 Human Performance Wing, Human Effectiveness Directorate, Air and Space Biosciences Division.

This position will directly support the Performance and Resilience Optimization (PRO)
Program of Record (PoR) to assist with operational Air Force experience to oversee administrative requirements for PRO, assist with research coordination, track PRO project execution metrics (cost, schedule, and performance), and develop/execute tech transition strategies to include delivering products to the user. Interface with RH and 711 HPW staff, as well as USAF experts and consultants in this field. Provide mental health program management expertise and serve as an Associate Investigator on human performance studies analyses and research.

The Henry M. Jackson Foundation for the Advancement of Military Medicine (HJF) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing military medicine. We serve military, medical, academic and government clients by administering, managing and supporting preeminent scientific programs that benefit members of the armed forces and civilians alike. Since its founding in 1983, HJF has served as a vital link between the military medical community and its federal and private partners. HJF's support and administrative capabilities allow military medical researchers and clinicians to maintain their scientific focus and accomplish their research goals.

Responsibilities

Lead the coordination and response to organization taskers, administrate requirement and interfacing with 711 HPW leadership and staff in support of PRO Program.
Serve as a scientific SME to the PRO PI for the identification of customer needs, new research lines of effort, and the design and implementation of psychological interventions to be studied under PRO RTD&E.
Assist PI with market research, scientific literature synthesis, and identifying requirements for time, manpower and budget to complete PRO projects.
Coordinate, plan and liaison with 711 HPW/RHB program leadership on behalf of the PRO portfolio regarding project goals, quarterly and annual milestones and resource status, and compliance with regulatory requirements.
Support the development of scientific inquiry and analyses based on their understanding of the needs and resources of the military customers. With the experience in and/or awareness of both military medicine and military operational conditions, the employee shall serve as the subject matter expert (SME) and scientific contributor to study design, coordination, and reporting.
Contribute to research projects by participating in data collection and interpreting data analyses as needed.
Provide program manager support by managing and tracking PRO project schedules, costs, technical performance and risk/opportunities.
Identify additional questions to be answered, provide/critique essential elements of analysis and provide alternatives/analytical techniques.
Travel to implement the intervention or related data collection.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Direct Supervisor: Directs team and work activities.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree required; master’s degree or higher preferred in Clinical, Counseling, or similar Behavioral and Mental Heatlth education from an accredited institution.
Minimum of 9 years' experience with 5 years operational or medical leadership experience with Air Force population within the last 10 years.

Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Experience as director of psychological health, a leadership position in and Air Force Research organization, or other operational positional that would provide candidate with a broad understanding of the behavioral health medical system in which the Air Force Warfighter operates.
Minimum of 2 years of research, program management and/or operational leadership withing the last 10 years focus on research administrative program management, evaluation of human subjects' experiments/data collection that can be in previously identified administrative leadership positions or publications in peer reviewed psychological or related journals.
Graduate course working and/or experience in scientific writing, programmatic resource management, and/or experience in scientific writing, programmatic resource management, and/or in writing published peered reviewed behavioral science research reports.
Solid Interpersonal skills, including the ability to clearly communicate verbally and in writing, build and maintain teams, and identify and resolve problems.
Demonstrated ability to plan, schedule, and coordinate activities to meet deadlines.
Working knowledge of a variety of software including but not limited to Microsoft Office, proposal/project tracking, and data analysis software.
Prior experiences in the life sciences strongly preferred.

This position will take place primarily in an office setting.

jobs.description:
Job Description

As a senior technical leader, the person in this position is expected to leverage OT cybersecurity expertise to manage product lines, drive business development, and build strong customer relationships while adhering to government and military processes and procedures. The person in this position is expected to: A) develop and execute product strategy and roadmaps for OT cyber defense products and platforms; B) lead vulnerability management, system assessment, and system and network forensics efforts within OT environments in conjunction with Cybercore portfolio and/or program managers, INL technical staff, and subcontractors with diverse technical backgrounds such as control systems engineers, control systems cyber security analysts, and cybersecurity researchers; and C) serve as a technical advisor to government, military, and industry customers and represent INL's OT cybersecurity capabilities externally.

Responsibilities

This exciting position requires senior-level technical product management skills, to include strategic planning, customer engagement, and driving product activities with technical staff. Key responsibilities include:

Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management
Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for OT cybersecurity-focused products and solutions.
Oversee the full lifecycle of products, from concept development to deployment and retirement, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and customer needs.
Identify market opportunities and emerging threats to continuously enhance product offerings.
Vulnerability Management & System Assessments
Lead efforts in vulnerability discovery and management within OT environments to identify and mitigate risks.
Conduct assessments of systems and products to evaluate security posture and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
System and Network Forensics
Oversee forensic analysis of OT systems and networks to investigate security incidents, identify root causes, and recommend remediation.
Develop and maintain processes for incident response and forensic investigations.
Customer Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with government, military, and industry customers to understand their unique needs and deliver tailored cybersecurity solutions.
Serve as a trusted advisor and technical expert, providing guidance and support to customers throughout the product lifecycle.
Business Development & Outreach
Collaborate with internal teams to identify new business opportunities and expand the reach of INL's OT cybersecurity products and services.
Represent INL at industry conferences, workshops, and forums to promote capabilities and establish partnerships.
Leadership & Collaboration
Act as a subject matter expert and mentor to other team members in the areas of OT cybersecurity, vulnerability management, system forensics, and product development.
Partner with cross-functional teams, including engineering, research, and operations, to ensure seamless integration of technical solutions.

In addition, the person in this position is expected to:

Work under limited direction and apply sound judgment to complex technical and business challenges while meeting product milestones and customer commitments.
Communicate technical information clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences, including senior government and industry stakeholders, and serve as the primary product spokesperson.
Build effective teams and ensure compliance with organizational policies and procedures.
Work extensively with external customers, sponsors, and partners as well as internal contacts across the Laboratory.

Minimum Qualification Requirements

Formal educational background and/or significant experience in one of the following areas: Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Technical Product or Program Management, or related fields.
Level 4 - Bachelor's Degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology or related field and at least 9 years of direct professional experience, or a Master's degree and 6 years of relevant experience, or PhD and 3 years of relevant experience.
Demonstrated experience in operational technology (OT) / industrial control systems (ICS) cybersecurity, to include vulnerability discovery and management, system assessments, and/or system and network forensics.
Experience managing technical products, platforms, or capabilities through their lifecycle in support of US Government and/or military sponsors.
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy "Q" clearance, with SCI, which requires US Citizenship.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, or Master of Business Administration (MBA) with technical experience/education in cybersecurity.
Active DOE "Q" or DoW Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.
Deep familiarity with representative physical processes and OT systems and components found throughout U.S. Critical Infrastructure.
Experience with OT/ICS incident response and forensic investigation methodologies and tools, and with industry standards.
Demonstrated success in business development, customer relationship management, and external outreach within the government, military, or critical infrastructure sectors.
Must be able to work in a secure environment to include handling/storing/processing classified information and adhere to physical and electronic protection standards.
Must be able to work under pressure, simultaneously addressing multiple complex tasks to meet commitments while maintaining quality of work and a professional interface.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, and work in an office and field/laboratory environment. The job requires hand/finger dexterity to keyboard or type, handle materials, manipulate tools, and reach with hands and arms. The job requires operation of job-related equipment and driving a vehicle. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds without assistance. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with the public is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager,  Recs, Revenue, and Engagement
jobs.description:
Our Mission

As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.

We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

Our Values

Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

The Role

At Tinder, our Recs, Revenue, and Engagement teams play a mission-critical role in shaping the core user experience by helping people "spark something new with someone new" through personalized recommendations, bringing users back at the right moment, and making sure they succeed once they're here.

As Senior TPM, you will drive high-impact, cross-functional programs across these three teams while keeping each team's day-to-day operations running smoothly. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Design, and Analytics, along with Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Localization, to bring structure to rapidly evolving plans and priorities, resolve dependencies before they become blockers, and deliver incredible user experiences at global scale.

Where You'll Work

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in Los Angeles, CA or Palo Alto, CA.

In This Role, You Will

Own end-to-end delivery for high-impact programs across Recs, Revenue, and Engagement from planning through launch, including the ongoing development of recommendation infrastructure and models for Recs; subscription, payments, and ads programs for Revenue; and lifecycle messaging and the CRM platform for Engagement.
Act as the connective tissue between Recs, Revenue, and Engagement and other product teams in the organization, tracking milestones, surfacing cross-team dependencies, driving alignment on ownership and sequencing, and mitigating risk across mobile, backend, ML, and web engineering teams.
Proactively identify and resolve issues by coordinating with teams to determine solutions and prioritize tasks; collaborate with teams as needed to improve existing processes while maintaining a high bar for both quality and velocity.
Provide clear, timely communications to executive and senior leadership on program health, including mission reports, status updates, and escalations that come with a recommended path forward, not just a status.

You'll Need

6+ years of experience in Technical Program Management for consumer mobile products at scale, preferably supporting recommendations, ranking, or personalization; monetization (subscriptions, payments, or ads); or growth and lifecycle messaging.
Proven ability to run a portfolio of concurrent programs across multiple teams, building delivery plans, dependency maps, release plans, and risk registers that stay current as priorities shift.
Demonstrated success in partnering with PMs, engineering leads, and senior leadership, cultivating strong cross-functional relationships and influencing outcomes in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
AI fluency, with hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to automate routine program management work like status reporting, documentation, and dependency tracking, and to accelerate cross-functional communication.
Expert-level proficiency in Jira and Jira Product Discovery, including configuring views, fields, and workflows, plus Confluence, Google Suite, and Figma.
Expertise in agile methodologies and a deep understanding of PDLC and SDLC best practices.

Nice To Have

Experience with subscription billing and payments, including Apple in-app purchase, Google Play Billing, web checkout, or alternative payment programs in regulated markets.
Working knowledge of the ML project lifecycle, from feature and data readiness through offline training and evaluation to online experimentation and rollout, and how planning for model work differs from planning for feature work.
Experience with programmatic ads, including ad placements, mediation, or SDK integrations on iOS and Android.
Familiarity with lifecycle and CRM messaging platforms (push, SMS, email) and the opt-in and regional compliance requirements that come with them.

As a Full-time Employee, You’ll Enjoy

Flexible Vacation, 10 Sick Days
Time off to volunteer and charitable donations matched up to $15,000 annually
Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage
100% 401(k) employer match up to 10%, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
100% paid parental leave (including for non-birthing parents) and family forming benefits
Investment in your development: mentorship through our MentorMatch program, access to 6,000+ online courses through Udemy, and an annual $3,000 stipend for your professional development
Investment in your wellness: access to mental health support via Modern Health, paid concierge medical membership, pet insurance, fitness membership subsidy, and commuter subsidy
Free subscription to Tinder Gold

Commitment to Inclusion

At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer. Tinder is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we welcome people of all sexes, gender identities, races, ethnicities, disabilities, and other lived experiences. Learn more here: https://www.lifeattinder.com/dei

If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please speak to your Talent Acquisition Partner directly.

#Tinder

The salary range for this position is $160,000- $175,000. Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of a position based in Los Angeles. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager (Data), London
jobs.description:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.

The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery.

Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.

The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you.

About Iso

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.

Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.

Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

Your impact

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Data who is passionate about accelerating drug discovery through the strategic delivery of large-scale, high-quality scientific datasets.

At IsoLabs, you will be an essential member of the Data team, bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research, Drug Discovery & Medical Research (DDMR), Data Engineering, and an extensive global network of scientific partners and Contract Research Organizations (CROs).

In this role, you will take ownership of the full program lifecycle for critical data generation and acquisition initiatives. You will design delivery frameworks, manage complex scientific and technical dependencies, and optimize the operational speed to deliver transformative datasets.

What You Will Do

Drive the delivery of high-impact data acquisition and experimental data generation programs, ensuring work converges on our core model-training and research milestones.
Partner closely with AI researchers, drug discovery scientists, data curators, data engineers, and legal/commercial teams to define clear program outcomes, governance structures, and delivery roadmaps.
Proactively map dependencies, identify critical path bottlenecks, and work alongside engineering and scientific stakeholders to triage technical issues across data schemas, transfer protocols, and automated quality control pipelines.
Serve as the primary technical program interface for external CROs and data generation partners; track operational cadence, monitor experimental assay deliverables against Statements of Work (SOWs), and lead technical reviews.
Oversee program-level financial commitments, monitor milestone-based delivery against purchase orders (POs), and maintain multi-quarter forward forecasts to support strategic planning.
Track and communicate program performance, data velocity, and dataset utilization to ensure our expanding Data Estate delivers measurable improvements in predictive and generative AI model performance. Champion continuous improvement across our data delivery machinery.

Skills And Qualifications

Essential:

Proven experience as a TPM, or Scientific Delivery Manager leading complex programs in a biotech, pharmaceutical, or an AI/ML tech environment.
Strong understanding of how different datasets can accelerate drug discovery and AI model development.
Familiarity with experimental data types used in drug discovery e.g. structure, bioactivity, ADMET, genomics, clinical data.
Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous, multi-faceted scientific and technical problems into structured, actionable workstreams with clear ownership and measurable KPIs.
Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and consensus-building skills across multidisciplinary teams - from software engineers and ML researchers to drug designers, commercial leaders, and external executives.
BSc, MSc, or PhD degree in Life Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, Informatics, or a related discipline
Solid grasp of how data flows through modern engineering infrastructure into ML pipelines, including understanding data schemas and data quality principles.
Advanced proficiency with modern project management and collaboration platforms (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Linear, or equivalent)

Nice to have:

Experience in health data management and the robust governance of human derived data.
Experience managing external scientific partnerships, multi-partner research consortia, or CRO delivery networks (e.g., managing SOWs, deliverables, and SLAs).
Working knowledge of machine learning concepts (supervised learning, active learning, data scaling laws) and how data quality/diversity affects model performance.
Familiarity with FAIR data principles, biomedical ontologies, and electronic lab notebook (ELN) data capture
Hands-on data manipulation skills (e.g., basic SQL, Python, or data visualization dashboards) to track delivery metrics and analyze program progress.
Experience with REST APIs/data exchange standards, ETL pipelines.
Experience managing program budgets, contract stages, and vendor procurement workflows

Culture and values

We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it.

Thoughtful

Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.

Brave

Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.

Determined

Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.

Together

Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.

Creating An Extraordinary Company

We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

Hybrid working

It’s hugely important for us to share knowledge and build strong relationships with each other, and we find it easier to do this if we spend time together in person. This is why we follow a hybrid model, and would require you to be able to come into the office 3 days a week
(currently Tuesday, Wednesday, and one other day depending on which team you’re in). If you have additional needs that would prevent you from following this hybrid approach, we’d be happy to talk through these if you’re selected for an initial screening call.

Please note that when you submit an application, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Data Products
jobs.description:
Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.

We’re seeking a stellar, highly experienced, Technical Program Manager to drive some of Bedrock’s most critical initiatives, including our Data Products. Assured Space Access Technologies, Inc. is a defense and engineering firm delivering phased array, radar, RF payload, and secure communications solutions to government and prime contractor customers. We are headquartered in Irvine, California. This role joins the Ground Based Radar team that designs, builds, and tests the transmit/receive modules at the core of our ground-based phased array radar.

Team:
Engineering, Ground Based Radar (GBR), Transmit/Receive Modules

Reports To:
GBR Technical Program Manager

Irvine, CA (on-site, with periodic supplier travel)

Employment Type:
Full-Time, Exempt

Base Salary Range:
$145,000 – $185,000 per year

Clearance:
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. An active clearance is preferred.

Position Summary

As the Technical Program Manager for the transmit/receive modules (TRMMs), you will own the plan that takes the module from design through first article and into production. Each module combines a high-power amplifier, low-noise amplifier, core beamforming chip, polarizer, and DC/DC power converter, and it is built from parts and subassemblies that come from several suppliers. You will hold the schedule, the builds, the supplier commitments, and the risk register for that module, and you will make sure the module team, the test stations team, and the radar program are working from the same plan.

You will report to the GBR Technical Program Manager and work daily with the TRMM technical lead, the systems engineer for the module, design engineers, test station engineers, and supply chain. This is a hands-on seat in a small team: you will build and maintain the schedule yourself, run the build and supplier meetings, and know the status of every open part and test lot. Technical depth matters here; you need to understand what the module does well enough to judge which risks are real.

Key Responsibilities

Schedule and Program Control

Build and own the integrated TRMM schedule from design release through first article, qualification, and production transition, tied to the GBR master schedule.
Track engineering, build, and test milestones, report status and earned progress to the GBR TPM, and flag slips early with recovery options.
Manage TRMM scope, configuration baselines, and engineering change impacts with systems engineering and configuration management.
Prepare and run TRMM inputs to program reviews, including design reviews, test readiness reviews, and customer status meetings.

Suppliers, Builds, and Materials

Coordinate with suppliers of module components, subassemblies, and power electronics on delivery schedules, technical status, and corrective actions.
Plan engineering and first article builds: kitting, long-lead parts, build travelers, and build-to-test handoffs with the test stations team.
Work with supply chain and materials operations on purchase orders, expediting, and material shortages.
Support supplier technical meetings, source inspection, and first article inspection with the engineering leads.

Risk and Production Transition

Own the TRMM risk and opportunity register, with clear owners, mitigation plans, and burn-down dates.
Track yield, test failures, and rework from first article builds and drive root cause and corrective action closure.
Lead production readiness planning: build rate, test station capacity, staffing, tooling, and supplier capacity for production quantities.
Coordinate the handoff from engineering builds to production with manufacturing, quality, and test.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, another engineering discipline, or a related technical field.
7+ years of experience in technical program management, hardware program management, or engineering leadership on defense or aerospace hardware programs.
Experience managing an RF, microwave, or electronics hardware product through first article and into production.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining integrated schedules in Microsoft Project, Primavera, Smartsheet, or a similar tool.
Experience managing suppliers and subcontracted hardware, including delivery tracking and corrective action.
Working understanding of RF hardware, transmit/receive modules, or phased array components sufficient to assess technical risk.
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship.
Ability to work on site in Irvine, CA and travel to suppliers as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with transmit/receive modules, active electronically scanned arrays, or RF microelectronics programs.
Experience with first article inspection (AS9102), production readiness reviews, and manufacturing transition.
Familiarity with earned value management or formal program controls on government contracts.
PMP or equivalent program management certification.
Active Secret or higher security clearance.
Experience at both a large defense prime and a smaller, fast-moving company.

What we offer

Medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k) with company matching; and paid time off.
Professional development support, including training and certifications relevant to your field.
Relocation assistance considered case by case.
Hands-on ownership of real scope in a growing defense technology company.

Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.

About The Role

This is Bedrock's first dedicated Safety Technical Program Manager
, a role built to establish the execution structure that lets us roll out new autonomy capabilities quickly without compromising safety rigor. As we scale to new machine types and expanded operational domains, we are evolving our safety practices toward more explicit, strategic execution.

You will own program execution for the safety, systems engineering, and state estimation work that makes autonomous heavy equipment safe to operate in the real world. This is a hands-on individual contributor role driving alignment and delivery across engineering, safety, autonomy, hardware, and field operations through influence, structure, and clear communication. You will be the connective tissue between safety strategy and technical delivery, making sure requirements are traceable, dependencies are visible, and risks surface early enough to act on. We are a startup that values agility. We believe that speed and safety are compatible when the traceability behind them is solid.

What You'll Do

Own planning and strategic execution for the safety and systems portions of the autonomy roadmap, from requirements through validated field deployment.
Support safety requirements being traceable, reusable across platforms and sites, and integrated into roadmaps from inception, partnering with safety and systems engineering on hazard analysis, validation evidence, and release readiness.
Build and maintain the validation plan spanning simulation and on-site testing, ensuring system-level changes are verified before they reach customers.
Map and actively manage dependencies and tradeoffs across systems, hardware, software, state estimation, and safety, weighing safety impact alongside schedule impact and identifying single points of failure on the critical path before they slip.
Drive program reviews, risk, and change management for multi-disciplinary, safety-critical initiatives, and provide reporting on roadmap health, delivery status, and safety implications clear enough to support both executive decisions and customer-facing discussions.
Translate field signals into prioritized engineering work and tracking issues to resolution.

What You'll Bring

7+ years of technical program management experience, including 2+ years leading programs involving safety-critical or high-integrity systems.
Domain experience in robotics, autonomous systems, aerospace, or another physical-world safety-critical domain, with a working understanding of the software, firmware, and hardware stacks behind real-world autonomy.
Working familiarity with a functional safety standard, such as ISO 26262 or IEC 61508, and how it shapes program structure, evidence, and release gates.
Enough working fluency in statistics and probability to interpret validation results and reliability metrics critically, not just track that they exist.
Understanding of the rigor, validation, and cross-functional coordination required to operate reliably in the physical world.
A track record of managing complex, cross-functional programs under ambiguity, taking systems from concept to production.
The ability to operate at a deep technical level and to distill complex risks and interdependencies into aligned, actionable plans for engineers and executives alike.
Strong dependency, risk, and change-management instincts in environments where safety and schedule are both non-negotiable.
A track record of thriving in fast-paced, high-ownership environments, with startup experience strongly preferred and a bias toward building structure that helps us scale through complexity.
Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a hands-on Business Operations Manager. You'll run the business side of a founder-led story studio: it's legal, money, production, and day-to-day operations. We’re looking for someone who translates leadership’s direction into action, resolves operational problems, and provides sound recommendations when a decision needs to be escalated to the CEO.

Operational priorities, owners, deadlines, and decisions are clear; recurring work reaches completion without leadership driving every step.
Financial paperwork, agreements, schedules, and records are accurate, current, and ready for review; exceptions are identified early, with a recommended next step.
Practical process improvements reduce recurring errors and delays, and the team can reliably use and maintain them.

Who You Are

You are a hands-on operator. You take as much pride in completing the work as in improving the process.
You bring judgment, discretion, and accountability. You know what you can decide, what needs approval, and how to keep work moving in the meantime.
You improve systems thoughtfully: understand what exists, identify the real problem, and make a practical change without unnecessary complexity.
You collaborate well with the founder, welcome candid feedback, and can explain a different approach with evidence—not ego.
You’re fluent in modern operations and automation tools, and able to discern when a tool improves the work and when it doesn’t.

Operations + Projects: Set and maintain operational priorities with leadership; translate decisions into completed actions; coordinate project handoffs and resolve competing requests within agreed authority.

Contracts + Deals: Prepare deal memos and booking documents from approved templates and confirmed terms; check entity details, dates, and amounts; manage signatures, logistics, and payment milestones. Route material exceptions to leadership or counsel.
Systems + Documentation: Build and maintain the automations and workflows that keep a multi-platform creative studio running.
Founder Support: Keep the decision queue, weekly priorities, and follow-through moving; support schedule and travel as needed.

Asana, Airtable, Slack, Dropbox, Word/Excel, DocuSign, and designated business-administration tools. Experience with comparable platforms is welcome.

PLUSES

Entertainment, production, talent-representation, or creative-agency experience
