Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product;
Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required;
Foster positive work relationships;
Comply with all firm policies and practices;
Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.   

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

Disclaimer

The job duties, requirements, and expectations for this position may be modified at the Firm’s discretion at any time. This job description does not change the at-will nature of employment.

Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

Accommodation   

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to permit individuals with a disability to perform the essential functions and responsibilities of the position or to participate in the job selection process. If you have a request for an accommodation during the application process, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.

new_jobs.description:
VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS

AXA is expanding its Employee Benefits activities internationally, supported by AXA EB Partners, a specialized Insurtech bringing together Employee Benefits expertise, digital delivery, data capabilities and integration excellence.

Founded in 2015, EB Partners brings together more than 75 internal and external team members across France, Japan and Vietnam. Its solutions currently support clients in 18 countries across Employee Benefits and Health.

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to join the EB Partners Service Excellence team and lead international initiatives around our Service Platform, a modular digital ecosystem designed for employees, employers, distributors and administrators.

You will work at the intersection of business, customer experience and technology, coordinating international stakeholders and helping local markets deliver engaging, scalable and locally relevant digital experiences. Projects span markets including France, Spain, Germany, Japan, Hong Kong and the Philippines, with opportunities to support further international expansion.

As Senior Project Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of Service Platform implementations and enhancements, from initial discovery and co-design through configuration, integration, UAT, deployment, adoption and post-go-live stabilization.You will:

Lead international implementations of Employee, Employer, Distributor and Admin portals, coordinating local AXA teams and EB Partners specialists.
Translate business and user needs into clear customer journeys, requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria and delivery roadmaps.
Manage project scope, planning, milestones, dependencies, risks, governance and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams covering UX/UI, low-code/no-code configuration, development and systems integration.
Promote a modular, reusable approach, leveraging existing global capabilities while adapting solutions to local business, regulatory and operational requirements.
Coordinate integration requirements including authentication and SSO, APIs, data exchanges, document services, notifications, e-signature, payment and third-party services where applicable.
Drive UAT, release readiness, training, deployment, adoption and post-launch support.
Help shape healthcare and wellbeing service ecosystems by coordinating insurers, healthcare or wellbeing providers and other partners.
Identify and assess opportunities for AI-enabled services, including AI chatbots and AI agents, and translate relevant use cases into pragmatic roadmaps considering business value, user experience, data readiness, integration, security, privacy and responsible AI.
Facilitate workshops, steering committees and working groups, ensuring clear decisions, ownership and follow-up.
Support local teams in building sustainable ownership of the platform and its configurable capabilities.

VOTRE PROFIL

You have at least 5 years of professional experience, with meaningful responsibility for digital portal, self-service, low-code/no-code or technology-enabled insurance projects. More than formal programme-management credentials, we value your ability to independently drive stakeholders, adoption and delivery outcomes.

You bring:

Proven experience delivering customer, partner, employee or comparable B2B/B2C digital portals, from discovery through production rollout and adoption.
Strong project management fundamentals across planning, governance, scope, risks, dependencies, UAT, release management and stakeholder decision-making.
A good understanding of digital delivery topics such as UX/UI, CMS or low-code/no-code platforms, authentication/SSO, APIs and data interfaces.
The ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements and delivery decisions for multidisciplinary teams.
Experience working in agile or hybrid environments and proficiency with Jira and Confluence.
Experience working in an international, matrixed environment with distributed teams.
Fluent written and spoken English. Business-level French is preferred for French projects.
Knowledge of Employee Benefits or insurance across Health, Protection or Pension is a strong advantage, as is familiarity with healthcare and wellbeing ecosystems.
Previous IT development experience is a plus

What Will Help You Succeed

You are comfortable taking ownership and moving projects forward without waiting for detailed direction. You know how to bring together stakeholders with different priorities, cultures and ways of working, and turn complexity into clear decisions and actions.

You combine a pragmatic, analytical mindset with strong communication skills. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, negotiating priorities and escalating risks early with practical options.

You are also curious about how emerging technologies, particularly generative AI, AI chatbots and AI agents, can improve digital services while meeting security, privacy, operational and responsible-AI requirements.

The environment you will join

EB Partners’ Service Platform combines reusable portal components with a low-code/no-code Builder platform to accelerate time to market while enabling local teams to adapt content and configurations.

The wider platform supports Employee Benefits journeys including enrolment, benefits and services, documents, claims, reporting and user administration, alongside capabilities such as digital claims management, enrolment automation and premium billing.

The role involves working across countries, cultures and time zones and may require international travel when necessary, mainly to EB Partners’ office in France.

Ready to help shape the next generation of digital Employee Benefits services? Join AXA EB Partners and help turn global capabilities into impactful local experiences

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

Nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs ! Les avantages que nous proposons à nos salariés sont nombreux.

Nous choisir, c’est bénéficier par exemple :

D’un package de rémunération complet comprenant un salaire fixe, un complément de rémunération variable, des primes, de la participation et de l’intéressement, la possibilité d’acquérir des actions AXA, ou encore des solutions d’épargne avantageuses ;
D’un cadre de travail flexible jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail possible par semaine (selon profil du poste), des tickets restaurant pour les jours télétravaillés ou encore une participation à l’achat d’un écran ou fauteuil ergonomique ;
D’une politique visant à concilier vie personnelle et vie professionnelle avec 28 jours de congés payés, entre 14 et 16 RTT selon les années, des formules de travail à temps partiel ou encore des jours d’absence rémunérées pour la rentrée scolaire ou un déménagement par exemple ;
De la possibilité de s’engager pour une cause qui vous tient à cœur grâce à nos associations telles que AXA Atout Cœur, AXA Compétences Solidaires ou encore AXA Prévention ;
Et bien plus encore ! Perspectives de développement des compétences et de carrières immenses, CE, conciergerie, offres privilèges, soutien en cas d’épreuve personnelle…On s’arrête là, la liste est longue !

VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL

Notre raison d’être chez AXA ? Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour le progrès humain en protégeant ce qui compte dans + de 50 pays. Accompagner près de 95 millions de clients à chaque étape de leur vie, une mission qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin à nos employés et agents (+ de 145 000 dans le monde !)

Chez AXA, nous sommes riches de nos singularités et accueillons tous les profils dans leur diversité. Au-delà de mener une politique inclusive engagée, nous agissons au quotidien en tant qu’employeur citoyen et responsable pour des causes sociétales & environnementales. Ces ambitions vous parlent ? Alors rejoignez un des leaders de l’assurance et venez changer le monde avec nous !

Présente sur l'ensemble du territoire, AXA France se distingue comme la filiale la plus importante du Groupe en termes de chiffre d'affaires et d'effectifs. Leader sur les marchés de l'assurance, de la santé et de la prévoyance, l'entreprise offre à ses équipes un cadre de travail moderne et agréable en "smartworking".

Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nous avons conçu un dispositif d'intégration baptisé "Welcome@AXA" pour accompagner vos premiers pas parmi nous avec attention. En lien avec nos engagements, nous célébrons chaque arrivée en agissant en faveur de la reforestation mondiale : depuis 2020, nous plantons un arbre pour chaque recrutement. Alors, prêt à postuler ?

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:

$110,500.00 - $152,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Role Overview

Central Engineering is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the development and commercialization of Central Engineering capabilities required by Etch products.

This role has end-to-end program accountability for complex, cross-functional initiatives spanning platform, robotics and automation, software, systems integration, and advanced R&D capabilities. The TPM will work across Etch product groups and Central Engineering functions to translate product and chamber requirements into clearly scoped engineering programs and drive those programs from requirements definition through development, system integration, lab readiness, customer introduction, and commercialization.

The TPM is expected to operate as an accountable program owner, not simply as a coordinator between organizations. The role owns program definition and execution across multiple engineering organizations, including scope, priorities, deliverables, schedule, resources, dependencies, risks, customer introduction, and Product Development Process execution.

Success requires strong technical judgment, systems thinking, program leadership, and the ability to drive execution across organizations where engineering resources and priorities must be negotiated and aligned.

Key Responsibilities

Program Ownership and Execution

Own end-to-end execution of cross-functional technical programs supporting Etch product development and commercialization, from initial requirements and program definition through engineering development, integration, lab validation, customer introduction, and release.
Serve as the single-point accountable owner for Product Development Process execution for assigned Central Engineering programs supporting Etch.
Establish clear program scope, objectives, technical requirements, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, dependencies, risks, and success criteria.
Drive programs to deliver integrated, working solutions, ensuring individual engineering deliverables come together successfully at the system level rather than managing functional activities independently.
Maintain accountability for program commitments and proactively drive recovery plans when technical, resource, schedule, or integration issues place commitments at risk.

Requirements And Systems Integration

Partner with Etch product and engineering organizations to scope and translate chamber and product requirements into requirements for Central Engineering capabilities, including platform, robotics and automation, software, controls, systems engineering, and advanced R&D technologies.
Drive requirements alignment across product, chamber, platform, software, robotics, and engineering organizations to ensure interfaces, dependencies, and system-level requirements are clearly understood.
Work across multiple technical disciplines to identify integration risks, architecture dependencies, qualification requirements, and gaps that could impact product readiness or customer introduction.
Ensure engineering solutions are developed and integrated to meet the needs of the Etch product roadmap and intended customer use cases.

Portfolio, Priority, and Resource Management

Manage a portfolio of Central Engineering programs and capabilities supporting Etch, maintaining visibility across program health, engineering resources, technical maturity, milestones, dependencies, risks, and customer commitments.
Lead the scoping and prioritization of new program requests and determine the engineering capabilities, resources, and organizations required for execution.
Negotiate and align priorities between Etch product groups and Central Engineering functions when resource capacity, technical dependencies, schedules, or competing priorities require trade-offs.
Identify portfolio-level resource constraints and cross-program dependencies early and drive decisions with appropriate engineering and product leadership.
Provide leadership with clear visibility into program health, resource needs, critical risks, decision points, and recovery actions.

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

Work across Product and Engineering disciplines to establish clear ownership and drive teams toward a common technical and program outcome.
Lead cross-functional execution across organizations responsible for platform, robotics, automation, software, controls, systems integration, and advanced engineering technologies.
Drive decisions across organizational boundaries and hold teams accountable for agreed deliverables, timelines, and technical outcomes.
Influence without direct authority by establishing clear requirements, data-driven priorities, decision frameworks, and escalation paths.
Resolve ambiguity around scope, ownership, priorities, interfaces, resources, and execution responsibility before those gaps affect program delivery.

Risk and Customer Introduction

Own identification and management of technical, integration, resource, schedule, qualification, and customer-introduction risks across assigned programs.
Establish mitigation and recovery plans for critical program risks and escalate decisions when cross-organizational alignment or leadership intervention is required.
Coordinate readiness across engineering teams for lab integration, system qualification, product release, and customer introduction.
Ensure issues discovered during system integration or customer introduction are driven to root cause, corrective action, ownership, and closure.

Qualifications

Required

BS or MS degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
5+ years of experience in high-tech product development, systems engineering, systems integration, engineering program management, or technical program management.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, multidisciplinary engineering programs involving multiple engineering organizations and technical dependencies.
Strong understanding of structured product development processes and experience driving programs from requirements through development, integration, qualification, and release.
Demonstrated ability to manage scope, schedules, resources, dependencies, risks, and technical integration across matrixed organizations.
Strong systems thinking and the ability to understand interactions between hardware, software, automation, controls, and product-level requirements.
Demonstrated ability to negotiate priorities and drive decisions and execution without direct authority.
Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate program status, risks, trade-offs, and decisions to technical and business leadership.

Preferred

Experience in semiconductor capital equipment or semiconductor manufacturing technology.
Experience supporting complex semiconductor equipment development involving process chambers, platforms, robotics and automation, controls, embedded or application software, and system integration.
Experience with New Product Development, Product Development Process, NPI, system qualification, and customer introduction.
Familiarity with Etch equipment and technologies such as process chambers, vacuum systems, RF/plasma systems, gas delivery, automation, robotics, controls, and related platform technologies.
Experience driving engineering execution across product engineering, systems engineering, software, hardware, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, service, and business organizations.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate is a technically credible program leader and systems thinker who can operate across both product and engineering organizations.

This person does not need to be the subject-matter expert in every technical discipline, but must be able to understand how the pieces come together at the system level, challenge assumptions, expose gaps and dependencies, and drive engineering organizations toward an integrated solution.

The ideal candidate can take an initially ambiguous product or chamber requirement and turn it into a well-defined technical program with clear requirements, architecture dependencies, engineering ownership, resources, priorities, milestones, risks, and customer deliverables, and then remain accountable until the solution is working and successfully introduced.

Why This Role Matters

Etch products increasingly depend on capabilities that span multiple Central Engineering organizations and technical disciplines. Successful execution requires more than coordination of individual engineering activities. It requires system-level ownership of how those capabilities are scoped, prioritized, developed, integrated, qualified, and delivered as a working solution.

The Technical Program Manager provides that ownership.

By managing both individual programs and the broader portfolio of Central Engineering commitments supporting Etch, this role will improve requirements clarity, resource and priority alignment, engineering integration, risk management, Product Development Process discipline, customer readiness, and predictability of execution.

Yes, 10% of the Time

Yes

new_jobs.title: Certification Operations and Policy Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About The Team

Customer Education helps customers build the practical skills and confidence to use AI and OpenAI products safely and effectively. We bring together customer insight, learning and enablement expertise, product signals, and measurement to help organizations move from access to durable adoption.

Within Customer Education, the Certification team helps individuals demonstrate competence for in-demand AI skills and helps customers and partners validate that their workforce has the skills they need to meet their AI-enabled business goals. Our work centers on the belief that learners should understand where to go to build skills and capabilities, how to demonstrate them, and what to pursue next. Similarly, Enterprise leaders should understand what each credential signifies and how it supports workforce readiness. We do this with transparency for the overall OpenAI credential framework and providing trusted, role-based certifications that verify practical capability.

About The Role

As Certification Operations and Policy Program Manager, you will build and run the processes that make OpenAI certifications accessible, fair, and reliable for candidates and the organizations that rely on them.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role on the Certification team, with no direct reports. You will define candidate policies, turn them into practical processes, and own their implementation as the program grows. This is not a general program-management or support-only role: it combines policy development with hands-on operational delivery.

You will work closely with the Certification team, product and technical teams, Legal, Privacy, Security, Accessibility, Support, and delivery vendors to define operational standards and apply policies consistently and fairly. You will connect the partners needed to turn certification requirements into workable candidate processes.

You will start with early certification launches and build reusable playbooks, service standards, and review processes for live and virtual delivery. Initially, you will also triage escalated vendor and candidate cases, resolve routine delivery or credential-access issues, and route substantive appeals through the established independent-review process.

Success means candidates know what to expect, delivery partners know what to do when something goes wrong, and sensitive decisions are documented and independently reviewed.

In This Role, You Will

Define candidate-facing policies and communications across the certification journey, including eligibility, registration, exam rules, retakes, exceptions, expiration, and renewal. Partner with the Certification team to translate program requirements into policy and with Legal, product, technical teams, and vendors to build the processes that uphold it.
Own the accommodations process from request through delivery. Work with Accessibility, Legal, and delivery partners on how requests are reviewed and implemented, and protect sensitive information throughout.
Own certification records and evidence workflows, including results, credential issuance and corrections, and case records. Put approved access, retention, and disclosure rules into practice with Privacy, Security, and platform teams.
Own vendor workflows and operational delivery standards, including handoffs, service levels, readiness checks, and escalation paths. Initially serve as the first point of contact for escalated delivery and credential-access cases, coordinating vendor fixes, candidate communications, and corrective actions.
Coordinate the response to exam integrity incidents, including suspected cheating, impersonation, or unauthorized sharing of exam content. Work with Security, Legal, and delivery vendors to document evidence, route cases to the appropriate decision-makers, and communicate and implement approved outcomes, such as score invalidation or credential revocation.
Administer appeals and independent reviews. Set intake and response timelines, assemble the case record, screen for conflicts of interest, and route decisions to qualified reviewers who were not involved in the original decision. Document and communicate outcomes without deciding cases you administer.
Coordinate Legal guidance on candidate policies, exceptions, and sensitive cases. Translate approved guidance into playbooks and training, and use trends in incidents, appeals, accommodations, and vendor performance to improve delivery.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have owned operations or candidate policy for professional certification, licensure, high-stakes assessment, or a similarly governed program.
Have taken a certification, licensure, or comparable high-stakes program from launch readiness through live delivery, and can show how you used operational data and candidate feedback to identify recurring problems and improve delivery.
Have experience working at a technology company in a fast-paced environment, setting priorities and delivering work amid changing requirements and evolving business needs.
Have defined candidate-facing policies and translated them into clear communications and operational workflows that internal teams and vendors can apply consistently.
Have built or run an accommodations process, implementing candidate accommodations while protecting sensitive information.
Have administered incidents, complaints, appeals, or exceptions, documenting decisions and maintaining review by people who were not involved in the original decision.
Have managed external delivery vendors against service standards and followed through when those standards were not met.
Have handled sensitive candidate, assessment, or credential records and worked with privacy or security teams on appropriate controls.
Have translated complex policies into candidate communications and operational guidance, and coordinated implementation across vendors and internal teams without direct reporting authority.
Have personally written operational playbooks, checked launch readiness, triaged cases, and improved delivery processes.
Have resolved time-sensitive operational issues within established policy and escalated exceptions to the appropriate decision-makers.
Have applied accessibility, fairness, and credential-integrity policies consistently in candidate-facing operations.

It’s a Plus If You Have Experience

Launching or scaling technical certifications across live and virtual delivery.
Working with exam delivery, identity verification, proctoring, credential issuance, or candidate support systems.
Supporting accreditation or quality audits for personnel certification programs.
Building repeatable operating processes across regions, delivery partners, or multiple certification programs.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

We are looking for an accomplished NPI Supply Chain Program Manager with a strong sense of accountability to join our CoE NPI Supply Chain Program team. Our Mission

CoE NPI Supply Chain is the strategic enterprise integration layer connecting Centers of Excellence (CoE), Business Units, and Global Supply Chain. The mission is to accelerate new product commercialization through cross-functional synergies, standardized supply-chain strategy and execution, improved cost and gross margin performance, and the timely proliferation of technology innovations into NPI programs.

The NPI SCPM is a success-critical enabler for CoE innovation implementation, driving:

Product Sourcing Strategy – agile, scalable, resilient product ramp through GSC ecosystems.
Product Cost Performance – product viability and gross margin performance.
Corporate Synergies – leverage across CoE teams, BUs, and Global Supply Chain.
Effective Implementation – deploy technology innovations and cost optimization into new products.

Scope spans Supply Chain Strategy & Resiliency, Lab Qual/Cut-in Management, CM Selection & HVM Readiness, Cost Apportionment Model (CAM), Best BoM Assessment, and Cost Reduction Roadmap & Execution across MCOS.

Strategic Sourcing & Commodity Management
Commodity strategy: market intelligence, supplier landscape, multi-year sourcing roadmaps.
Supplier selection and qualification: RFx, technical/commercial evaluation, CM selection for HVM readiness.
Negotiation and contracting: pricing, SOWs, T&Cs, and TCO optimization.
CAM, should-costing, Best BoM scenarios, and cost reduction roadmap execution.
Supply chain resiliency: dual sourcing, risk mitigation, and lab qual / cut-in management.

End-to-end planning: scope, schedule, critical path, dependencies, milestones.
Execution rigor: operating cadence, action tracking, stakeholder readouts.
Risk & issue management: RAID logs, mitigation, escalation, decision logs.
Vendor/partner coordination and governance across internal/external teams.

Semi supply chain: lead-times, allocation, shortage management, lifecycle/obsolescence.

Polymers & Plastics precision machining
Laser & Sensors – optical, motion, temperature, pressure, and process sensors.
Solid State Batteries – next-generation energy storage, cell chemistry, and qualification.

new_jobs.title: Information Security Analyst
new_jobs.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Information Security Analyst is primarily responsible for reviewing and analyzing the various security systems we have in place and determining whether further investigation or remediation is required in order to maintain the integrity of the firm’s systems and information. This position plays a critical role in the malware kill chain, acting independently at the prevent, detect and respond levels of information security.

Location

This position can sit in any US office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Aligns security alert review and hunting to prescribed Incident Response Playbook.
Conducts limited investigations into security breaches at firm sites using high-fidelity alerts and tools within the environment, MSSP and online.
Reviews alerts generated by security detection tools, correlates with device logs, packets capture and all forms of telemetry; interprets data.
Maintains up-to-date information in alert handling tools.
Where firm SLA governs timing, the analyst must work within the timing bounds to acknowledge and resolve alerts.
Vigilantly protects client and firm data, ensuring proper handling and protection electronically, physically and verbally.
Other duties as assigned.

Skills And Competencies

Must have detailed experience of TCP/IP.
Strong understanding of Windows operating systems.
Experience scripting in PowerShell, Perl, or Python.
Preferred experience includes: experience with Snort or other intrusion detection tools; anomaly detection, full-package capture; centralized logging and monitoring tools such as Splunk; Nessus/Security Center; and experience operating in and complying with ISO 27001:2013.
Understanding a common malware as well as typical attack chain.
Understanding of the common technologies found in enterprise IT environments including datacenter and Internet edge technologies.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Education

Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or related field required.

Certifications

CISSP, SSCP, GCIA or GCIH certification highly preferred.

Years Of Experience

4 years of IT or security experience.

Essential Job Expectations

While the specific job requirements of a DLA Piper position may vary depending upon scope of the job and area of specialty, there are certain universal requirements that are expected of all DLA Piper employees, which include but are not limited to:

Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties;

Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product;
Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required;
Foster positive work relationships;
Comply with all firm policies and practices;
Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.   

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

Disclaimer

The job duties, requirements, and expectations for this position may be modified at the Firm’s discretion at any time. This job description does not change the at-will nature of employment.

Application Process    

Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to permit individuals with a disability to perform the essential functions and responsibilities of the position or to participate in the job selection process. If you have a request for an accommodation during the application process, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.    

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship or support.

The firm’s expected hiring range for this position is $80,348 - $127,757 depending on the candidate’s geographic market location.

The compensation offered for employment will also be dependent on other factors including the candidate’s experience, skills, educational and professional background, and overall qualifications. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance, and 401(k).

new_jobs.description:
About Druva

Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.

Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

Role Purpose & Impact

The Senior Billing Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of customer billing activities. This position is responsible for managing complex billing transactions, reviewing contractual requirements, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining compliance with company policies and accounting standards.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented professional with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a solid understanding of order-to-cash processes, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

In addition to daily billing operations, the Senior Billing Analyst will help identify opportunities for process improvement, strengthen internal controls, and leverage emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools, to drive automation, enhance operational efficiency, and support scalable billing processes.

What You’ll Do

Sales Order Processing and Billing Operations

Process sales orders and customer invoices accurately and timely using Salesforce (SFDC) and NetSuite.
Review and validate sales orders against signed customer agreements, including customer information, products, pricing, billing schedules, and payment terms, to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Identify missing information, order discrepancies, and non-standard contract terms, escalating exceptions to senior team members or management as appropriate.
Ensure transactions are processed in accordance with established billing procedures, company policies, and operational deadlines.
Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation for sales orders, invoices, and billing transactions.

Billing Inquiries and Dispute Resolution

Respond to internal and external customer billing inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
Research billing discrepancies, invoice questions, and customer account issues.
Partner with relevant stakeholders to investigate billing discrepancies, resolve customer disputes, and ensure timely resolution of billing-related issues.
Assist with processing billing corrections, credit memos, and adjustments in accordance with established procedures.
Track outstanding billing issues and follow through to ensure timely resolution.
Escalate complex or unresolved issues to senior team members or management.

Reconciliations and Financial Close Support

Assist with reconciling third-party royalty and channel sales reports against internal order and billing data.
Identify and research discrepancies between external reports and internal transaction records.
Support month-end and quarter-end close activities, including reconciliations and assigned reporting tasks.
Assist in preparing supporting schedules, transaction details, and documentation for accounting close activities.
Ensure assigned deliverables are completed accurately and within established deadlines.

Internal Controls and Compliance

Follow established order-to-cash accounting policies, internal controls, and standard operating procedures.
Support internal control activities and assist with documentation required for SOX compliance.
Assist with internal and external audit requests by gathering transaction records and supporting documentation.
Ensure proper documentation and audit trails are maintained for billing-related transactions.
Identify and communicate potential processing errors, control issues, or policy exceptions to management.

Process Improvement and Systems Support

Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy, processing efficiency, and operational workflows.
Assist with maintaining and updating standard operating procedures and process documentation.
Support system enhancements, user acceptance testing, and implementation of new billing processes or tools.
Participate in operational improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects as assigned.
Explore and leverage AI-powered solutions to streamline billing workflows, improve data accuracy, reduce manual processes, and enhance operational effectiveness while maintaining appropriate financial controls.
Assist with preparing reports and ad hoc analyses to support billing operations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Communication

Collaborate with Order Management, Revenue Accounting, Accounts Receivable, Sales, Legal, and Operations to ensure alignment on contractual requirements, billing processes, and operational improvements.
Communicate order discrepancies, processing delays, and outstanding issues clearly and proactively.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain missing information and resolve transaction-related questions.
Provide timely status updates on assigned tasks, outstanding items, and escalations.
Demonstrate accountability and ownership of assigned responsibilities while seeking guidance when appropriate.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
5+ years of progressive experience in billing operations, accounts receivable, revenue operations, or a related finance function.
Strong understanding of billing processes, order-to-cash workflows, and financial controls.
Experience managing complex billing transactions, reconciliations, and billing adjustments.
Proficiency with ERP or financial systems, preferably NetSuite or a comparable platform.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in SaaS, subscription-based, or technology companies.
Familiarity with recurring revenue models, multiyear contracts, and subscription billing.
Experience with Salesforce (SFDC) and NetSuite.
Basic knowledge of revenue accounting and revenue recognition concepts.
Familiarity with channel partner, reseller, or distributor billing arrangements.
Understanding of SOX compliance and financial internal controls.
Experience supporting financial close activities, reconciliations, or process improvements.
AI Fluency: Familiarity with AI-powered tools and technologies, with the ability to leverage AI to improve operational efficiency, automate repetitive tasks, analyze data, and enhance accuracy across billing and finance processes.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

Success in this role will be measured by:

Accuracy and timeliness of sales order processing and customer invoicing.
Adherence to established billing procedures, policies, and operational deadlines.
Timely identification and escalation of order discrepancies and billing exceptions.
Timely resolution and follow-up of billing inquiries and assigned issues.
Accuracy and completeness of transaction documentation and supporting records.
Timely completion of assigned reconciliations and financial close activities.
Consistent compliance with internal controls and documentation requirements.
Effective communication and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and continuous development of technical skills.
Contributions to process improvements and operational efficiency.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Innovation is how we operate, not a side project. You’ll work in a culture that values bold thinking and continuous improvement, where global teams experiment, iterate, and turn new ideas into products customers can rely on.

If you’re looking for high-ownership work, visible impact, and a culture that values innovation, collaboration, accountability, and growth—where you’ll be trusted to lead and empowered to build—you’ll thrive at Druva.

What We Offer

The pay range for this position is expected to be between $123,000 and $172,333/year;
however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized, non-discriminatory factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary annual bonus or commissions, and equity. Additionally, full-time employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits program, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) retirement plan, life and disability insurance coverages, and other benefits the Company may offer from time to time.

new_jobs.description:
Who are we?

Volumetric Building Companies
( VBC
) is a vertically integrated global volumetric construction leader, headquartered in Philadelphia, PA. with locations across the United States and in Europe in the UK, Poland and Serbia.

Utilizing our technology-enabled design and engineering model, precision-driven manufacturing capabilities, and project-proven modular construction expertise, the company’s focus is on providing high quality, sustainably produced buildings in less time across varied market sectors including housing and hospitality.

As we grow, we are continually and very selectively adding top talent to our team. Our engaging culture is one that promotes teamwork, innovation, continuous learning, open and candid communications, and respect and support for one another, and for the communities in which we operate.

If you think you are one of the best at what you do and want to join us on our journey to build the future and improve lives
, then we’d love to hear from you!

About The Role

The Assistant Project Manager
will be a member of VBC’s U.S. Project Delivery Team and will support the planning and development of projects from early concept and design through project handoff to the execution team. Working closely with Project Managers, Estimating, Design, Procurement, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams, this role will help establish project scope, schedule, budget, and execution strategies to position projects for successful delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with foundational experience in the AEC, construction, engineering, or manufacturing industries who is ready to take the next step in their career. The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment while developing the skills necessary to grow into a Project Manager role.

Key Responsibilities

Preconstruction & Project Planning

Support the development of projects from early concepts through design development and transition to project execution.
Assist Project Managers with establishing project scope, schedule, budget, and key project milestones.
Review contract documents, drawings, specifications, and other project documentation to understand project requirements.
Assist with constructability reviews and identify potential design, cost, schedule, and execution risks.
Support development and maintenance of project execution plans and preconstruction deliverables.
Assist with identifying project assumptions, exclusions, constraints, and potential scope gaps.
Participate in project kickoff, design review, and preconstruction meetings.

Estimating & Budget Support

Support the review and development of project budgets and cost estimates.
Assist with tracking design development and scope changes that may impact project cost.
Coordinate with Estimating and Procurement teams to validate pricing, quantities, and material requirements.
Assist with value engineering exercises and identification of cost-saving opportunities.
Support preparation of budget updates, cost reports, and other financial project documentation.

Design & Document Coordination

Coordinate with internal and external design teams to track project design progress and deliverables.
Review architectural and engineering drawings for completeness, coordination, and alignment with project requirements.
Assist with managing RFIs, design clarifications, and other project correspondence during preconstruction.
Maintain current drawings, specifications, and project documentation within VBC’s project management systems.
Track design changes and communicate potential impacts to scope, schedule, budget, and manufacturing.

Schedule & Procurement Planning

Assist with development and maintenance of project schedules from design through manufacturing and construction.
Track project milestones, deliverables, approvals, and dependencies.
Identify and communicate potential schedule risks, delays, and areas requiring escalation.
Support procurement planning and tracking, with particular focus on long-lead materials and critical project components.
Coordinate with Procurement, Manufacturing, and Project Delivery teams to ensure project requirements are understood and achievable.

Cross-Functional Project Coordination

Develop strong working relationships with Project Managers, Project Architects, Systems, Estimating, Procurement, Manufacturing, and other internal teams.
Support communication and coordination across multiple disciplines to ensure project requirements are aligned.
Participate in project meetings and prepare and distribute meeting minutes and action items.
Track open issues, decisions, deliverables, and action items through resolution.
Assist in preparing project status updates and reporting project health to Project Management leadership.

Project Handoff & Continuous Improvement

Support the transition of projects from preconstruction into project execution and manufacturing.
Ensure project scope, budget, schedule, design documentation, procurement requirements, and key risks are clearly communicated during handoff.
Assist with identifying lessons learned and opportunities to improve VBC’s preconstruction and project delivery processes.
Contribute to standardization, process improvement, and operational efficiency initiatives.
Develop the knowledge and project management skills necessary to independently manage projects in the future.

Communication & Professional Development

Represent VBC internally and externally in a manner that reflects the company’s brand, values, and commitment to excellence.
Maintain clear, professional communication with clients, consultants, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Demonstrate a willingness to learn, take ownership, and progressively assume greater responsibility.

About You

Bachelor’s degree in construction management, architecture, engineering, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in construction, architecture, engineering, manufacturing, project coordination, estimating, or a related AEC environment; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
Demonstrated ability to read and understand architectural and engineering drawings.
Basic understanding of construction processes, project schedules, budgets, and contract documents.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with individuals at all levels of an organization.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Project.
Experience with project management or industry-specific software such as SAP, BIM 360, Smartsheet, Procore, or similar platforms preferred.
Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a cross-functional team.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.
Positive, proactive attitude with a demonstrated desire to grow into a project management leadership role.

Equal Opportunity

Experience in project managing large multi-functional projects.
Advanced experience with wireless network design and implementation and strong vendor management skills

Experience in planning, forecasting and project management

Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Project Manager, Services Technology & Tooling, you will be tasked with helping make our expanded global partnership successful for customers by coordinating the operational technology required for the SentinelOne and partner services relationship. This partnership brings together SentinelOne's AI-powered security platform and our partners' expertise in managed detection and response, managed SIEM, and incident response, and as partner-delivered services grow, SentinelOne remains committed to clear customer ownership, technical quality, and measurable results. This is a delivery-focused program role managing the workstreams covering approved platform access, tenant and environment architecture, integrations, workflow tooling, and technical cutover readiness, requiring disciplined coordination across IT, InfoSec, Product, service operations, and partner technical teams without bypassing security or access controls to meet schedule dates.

Capture the final access model, integration documentation, and operational handoff required for steady-state support.

3 or more years of experience in technical project management, business systems implementation, IT delivery, or enterprise platform operations.

PMP, Agile, or similar project-management training is highly desirable.

Reporting to the Digital Technology Solutions (DTS) PMO, the Principal Project Manager is a senior delivery leader responsible for driving complex, cross-functional technology initiatives to successful and predictable outcomes. With primary accountability for the IT and engineering components of an initiative, this role leads delivery across the full project lifecycle, from planning and mobilization through execution, implementation, and transition to operations.

The Principal Project Manager brings structure, discipline, and transparency to complex initiatives by establishing clear scope, integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and accountability. They work closely with engineering teams, business partners, operational teams, vendors, and project and program management counterparts across Alignment to connect work across organizational boundaries and maintain momentum toward shared outcomes.

Success in this role requires strong relationship building and collaboration. The Principal Project Manager establishes trusted partnerships across the company, creates alignment among diverse stakeholders, anticipates delivery challenges, surfaces risks and dependencies early, facilitates timely decisions, and helps teams navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.

The Principal Project Manager also contributes to the continued development of the DTS PMO and our project delivery capabilities. Working collaboratively with PMO leadership, project managers, engineering leaders, and partners across Alignment, this role will lead or contribute to selected workstreams focused on creating repeatable and scalable project management processes, artifacts, tools, reporting, and ways of working that enable predictable delivery. The Principal Project Manager will bring practical experience and lessons learned from active project delivery into this work, helping ensure our standards are useful, adaptable, and effective in practice.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

Strategic Project Management Framework: Design, implement, and govern a standardized, scalable project management methodology (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) that is tailored to our organization's needs and ensures consistency, predictability, and quality in project delivery.
Process Optimization Leadership: Act as the lead subject matter expert in process improvement. Conduct comprehensive analysis of current business processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for automation and optimization.
Capacity and Demand Management: Develop, implement, maintain and report on the capacity of the IT organization to intake work, prioritize it, and report on demand for those resources. This will support work execution and resource planning.
Change Management: Lead the change management initiatives required to ensure the successful adoption of new project management methodologies and optimized business processes across all departments. This includes developing training materials, conducting workshops, and providing ongoing support.
Enterprise Project Management: Lead multiple complex, enterprise-wide initiatives with significant financial and operational impact.
Mentorship and Coaching: Serve as a senior-level mentor and coach to project managers and operational teams. Provide expert guidance on best practices in project planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder communication, as well as process analysis and continuous improvement techniques.
Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for both project health and process efficiency. Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that provide executive leadership with a clear, data-driven view of our project portfolio and operational performance.
Tooling and Technology: Evaluate, select, and optimize project management and business process management (BPM) software and tools to support our methodologies and improve overall efficiency.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with senior leaders and stakeholders across the organization to align project and process optimization initiatives with strategic business goals. Facilitate cross-functional teams to drive and implement complex improvements.
Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and address risks related to project execution and process failures. Develop and implement strategies to mitigate these risks and ensure business continuity.
Continuous Improvement Culture: Foster a culture of continuous improvement by promoting lean principles, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.

Required Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) and/or other relevant certifications (e.g., Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Agile, Scrum Master) are required.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field.
Technical & Analytical Skills: Deep expertise in process mapping, data analysis, and the use of process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen).
Leadership & Influence: Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to influence and drive organizational change without direct authority.
Strategic Thinking: Proven ability to develop and execute a strategic vision for project and process management that aligns with and supports business growth.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a meticulous attention to detail.

new_jobs.description:
Customer Success Project Manager
Job Description

Job Title:
Customer Success Project Manager (CSPM)
Location:
Fully Remote
Employment Type:
Full-time
Salary Range:
Base $60,000–$70,000
Work Schedule:
Core business hours 9–5 pm EST

About Lasso Up

Lasso Up is a growth marketing agency that helps Home Builders, Med Spas, and B2B brands stop chasing random marketing tactics and start generating consistent leads. We replace marketing chaos with a proven Growth Marketing Program, built through strategic branding, web design and development, SEO, content, email, social, and digital advertising, and designed to attract, nurture, and convert new leads.

Our Customer Success Project Managers make that program real. Leadership sets each client's strategy; you turn it into a plan, a team, and a launch. If you take ownership of timelines, communicate directly, and love seeing a well-run project land, this is the place for you.

Role Overview

As a CSPM at Lasso Up, you'll lead new Growth Marketing Program clients through their first 100 days, the most resource-heavy and important stretch of the program, and run complex one-time projects like website builds, branding, and campaign launches. You'll keep scope, budget, and timeline on track with customers externally while orchestrating implementation by our content, design, development, and external teams internally. Once a program is up and running, you'll keep that client in your book of business as their trusted point of contact.
You'll sit on our Customer Success team, working alongside our Customer Success Managers and reporting to the VP of Operations. This role is not a strategist seat: leadership sets each client's strategy, and you own the execution, translating it into project plans, customer-facing assets, and clear direction for the team.

We're looking for a specific kind of person: detail oriented, high driving, and a critical thinker who learns fast. You also must love our customers as much as we do!

We're also investing heavily in AI. Every team member at Lasso Up uses tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and our custom-built AI solutions daily. For this role, hands-on experience using or building with AI is a real advantage.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary of $60,000–$70,000, based on experience
Fully remote — work from anywhere!
Flexible PTO year one, then unlimited PTO
Dead call weeks (no client meetings) at end of each quarter and over Christmas break
15 Paid Federal Holidays
Health insurance options
Simple IRA plan with 3% company match
Company equipment
Paid training and development
Clear promotional path as you take on more accounts and larger projects

Key Responsibilities

Project Management

Lead new Growth Marketing Program clients through onboarding and their first 100 days.
Run multiple one-time projects at once, including website builds, branding, and ad campaign launches, from kickoff through launch.
Manage scope, budget, and timelines across client deliverables, and flag risks early.
Build and manage project boards in Teamwork (or equivalent: Jira, Azure DevOps, Asana, Monday): load tasks, assign resources and dates, and write clear requirements for designers, developers, and writers.
Coordinate with internal Lasso Up teams and external vendors to assign tasks and ensure on-time execution.
Handle scope changes and escalations by presenting clear options to clients: scope, timeline, or cost.
Quality check deliverables before they reach the client.

Account Management

Build and maintain strong client relationships that drive retention, loyalty, and referrals.
Spot upsell opportunities that align with client goals and the Growth Marketing Program, and partner with leadership to scope and price them.
Manage contract renewals and track progress against each client's established benchmarks.
Conduct quarterly reviews to measure progress and communicate results clearly.
Actively seek client referrals and reviews, and request feedback to continuously improve service.
Report on project progress, performance, and ROI on a consistent cadence.
Develop deep knowledge of Lasso Up's services so you can execute confidently and answer client questions.
Manage relationships with external vendors and internal stakeholders to keep work moving.

Strategy Implementation

Take the strategy leadership sets for each client and translate it into project plans, timelines, and Teamwork tasks.
Carry strategy forward into customer-facing assets: presentation materials, website instructions, and ad direction.
Communicate the plan clearly to the service team and the client so everyone is executing toward the same goals.
Use lead generation and results data to confirm work stays aligned with client objectives, and escalate strategy questions to leadership.

AI & Technology

AI is a real part of how we work—not optional, not someday. We're looking for someone who already uses it well and wants to build with it.

Bring hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in your daily work, and put them to work at Lasso Up alongside our custom tools: project planning, requirements, status reporting, client prep, and documentation.
Build and improve AI-assisted workflows that make project delivery faster and more consistent, from task setup to recaps and reporting.
Bring ideas for how AI can improve client results or internal efficiency, and share what's working with the team.
Stay current on what AI can do.
Use AI with good judgment. You're the expert. The tool supports your thinking.

Client Communication & Issue Resolution

Run regular client meetings with clear agendas focused on deliverables, timelines, and next steps, meeting more frequently during a program's first 100 days.
Lead effective presentations: snapshot reporting, a clear purpose, and a defined call to action tailored to your client.
Address client concerns directly and with empathy—take ownership of issues and drive collaborative solutions.
Document all client communications and ensure updates are clearly shared with the right people.
Manage up with demanding clients and stakeholders, and navigate difficult conversations without losing momentum.

Required Skills & Qualifications

3–5 years of project management experience, with a track record of leading project implementations to a successful launch.
A project management certification of any kind, such as PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster, or SAFe Scrum Master.
Experience leading cross-functional teams of designers, developers, and external stakeholders.
Excellent stakeholder management, including managing up with clients.
Comfort running multiple accounts and projects at once without losing sight of timelines, budgets, deliverables, or scope.
A working understanding of website design and development.
Proficiency with a project management tool such as Teamwork, Asana, Monday.com, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) in a professional setting.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with a client-first approach.
Proficiency in Google Suite or Microsoft Suite.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building with AI: custom GPTs or Claude Projects, prompt libraries, or automations (Zapier, Make, or similar).
Marketing, agency, or technology company experience. Any background where you've led designers and developers to launch qualifies.
Familiarity with SEO, content, email, social, or paid ads.
Experience with a CRM (HubSpot or equivalent).
Hands-on experience with SEMrush, Google Analytics, CallRail, or Canva.

What Great Looks Like Here

Average project managers track tasks. Great ones drive launches. Our best performers share four things:
They over-communicate. Clients and teammates always know where things stand.
They sweat the details. They catch the slipped date, the missing requirement, and the out-of-scope ask before it becomes a problem.
They have strong agency. Work moves forward without being pushed.
They address conflict directly. Hard conversations happen, and they move through them.

What Success Looks Like After Year One

One-time projects launched on time, on budget, and in scope.
New Growth Marketing Program clients onboarded smoothly through their first 100 days.
Strong, trusted relationships across your book of business.
AI built into how you plan, run, and report on projects.

Growth Path

We promote from within. This role sits on our Customer Success team, and strong performers have a clear path to senior and leadership roles, with each level defined by measurable competencies—not tenure. If you want to grow, the track is here and the standards are clear.

Why Join Lasso Up?

We're not your typical agency. We're a fully remote team of growth partners who take full ownership of results—for our clients and for each other. We don't chase random tactics or trends. We focus on what actually works, and we build systems that prove it. See it for yourself at lasso-up.com/case-studies.

We're also building a team that uses AI as a real working tool—not a novelty. If you lean into new technology and want to be ahead of where the industry is going, you'll fit right in.

If you want a role where you turn plans into launches—for businesses that deserve to grow—this is it.

Our Core Values

Lead and Respond with Positivity
Over-Communicate
Take Extreme Ownership
Be a Problem Solver
Maintain a Growth Mindset
Keep it Simple

We believe exceptional work and a healthy life aren't in conflict. We build in time to recharge—because staying sharp, positive, and motivated is part of doing great work.

How to Apply

Ready to turn proven growth strategies into launches that work—for our clients and for your career? Submit your resume and a cover letter outlining a project you led to launch and why you're the right project manager for this role.

Own program communications strategy for employees, managers, and leaders.

Define program-specific success metrics and develop the evaluation approach to track them.
Look at who our programs reach and use insights to recommend improvements to learning experiences.

Partnerships & Vendor Management

Manage day-to-day vendor relationships, from scoping and contracting through delivery and evaluation.
Partner with HRBPs, People Ops, Match Group Talent & Culture, facilitators, and subject matter experts to coordinate program development and delivery, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure learning experiences meet employee needs.

Experience defining success metrics and evaluating program impact.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

As a senior technical leader, the person in this position is expected to leverage OT cybersecurity expertise to manage product lines, drive business development, and build strong customer relationships while adhering to government and military processes and procedures. The person in this position is expected to: A) develop and execute product strategy and roadmaps for OT cyber defense products and platforms; B) lead vulnerability management, system assessment, and system and network forensics efforts within OT environments in conjunction with Cybercore portfolio and/or program managers, INL technical staff, and subcontractors with diverse technical backgrounds such as control systems engineers, control systems cyber security analysts, and cybersecurity researchers; and C) serve as a technical advisor to government, military, and industry customers and represent INL's OT cybersecurity capabilities externally.

Responsibilities

This exciting position requires senior-level technical product management skills, to include strategic planning, customer engagement, and driving product activities with technical staff. Key responsibilities include:

Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management
Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for OT cybersecurity-focused products and solutions.
Oversee the full lifecycle of products, from concept development to deployment and retirement, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and customer needs.
Identify market opportunities and emerging threats to continuously enhance product offerings.
Vulnerability Management & System Assessments
Lead efforts in vulnerability discovery and management within OT environments to identify and mitigate risks.
Conduct assessments of systems and products to evaluate security posture and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
System and Network Forensics
Oversee forensic analysis of OT systems and networks to investigate security incidents, identify root causes, and recommend remediation.
Develop and maintain processes for incident response and forensic investigations.
Customer Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with government, military, and industry customers to understand their unique needs and deliver tailored cybersecurity solutions.
Serve as a trusted advisor and technical expert, providing guidance and support to customers throughout the product lifecycle.
Business Development & Outreach
Collaborate with internal teams to identify new business opportunities and expand the reach of INL's OT cybersecurity products and services.
Represent INL at industry conferences, workshops, and forums to promote capabilities and establish partnerships.
Leadership & Collaboration
Act as a subject matter expert and mentor to other team members in the areas of OT cybersecurity, vulnerability management, system forensics, and product development.
Partner with cross-functional teams, including engineering, research, and operations, to ensure seamless integration of technical solutions.

In addition, the person in this position is expected to:

Work under limited direction and apply sound judgment to complex technical and business challenges while meeting product milestones and customer commitments.
Communicate technical information clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences, including senior government and industry stakeholders, and serve as the primary product spokesperson.
Build effective teams and ensure compliance with organizational policies and procedures.
Work extensively with external customers, sponsors, and partners as well as internal contacts across the Laboratory.

Minimum Qualification Requirements

Formal educational background and/or significant experience in one of the following areas: Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Technical Product or Program Management, or related fields.
Level 4 - Bachelor's Degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology or related field and at least 9 years of direct professional experience, or a Master's degree and 6 years of relevant experience, or PhD and 3 years of relevant experience.
Demonstrated experience in operational technology (OT) / industrial control systems (ICS) cybersecurity, to include vulnerability discovery and management, system assessments, and/or system and network forensics.
Experience managing technical products, platforms, or capabilities through their lifecycle in support of US Government and/or military sponsors.
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy "Q" clearance, with SCI, which requires US Citizenship.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, or Master of Business Administration (MBA) with technical experience/education in cybersecurity.
Active DOE "Q" or DoW Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.
Deep familiarity with representative physical processes and OT systems and components found throughout U.S. Critical Infrastructure.
Experience with OT/ICS incident response and forensic investigation methodologies and tools, and with industry standards.
Demonstrated success in business development, customer relationship management, and external outreach within the government, military, or critical infrastructure sectors.
Must be able to work in a secure environment to include handling/storing/processing classified information and adhere to physical and electronic protection standards.
Must be able to work under pressure, simultaneously addressing multiple complex tasks to meet commitments while maintaining quality of work and a professional interface.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, and work in an office and field/laboratory environment. The job requires hand/finger dexterity to keyboard or type, handle materials, manipulate tools, and reach with hands and arms. The job requires operation of job-related equipment and driving a vehicle. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds without assistance. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with the public is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
